articleTitle: Compound Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Based on Fastica and Granger Causality Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to separate the multi-channel compound fault signals of rolling bearing and it is difficult to determine the type of compound fault through the separated signals, a compound fault diagnosis method of rolling bearing based on Fast Independent Component Analysis (FastICA) and Granger Causality Analysis was proposed. Firstly, the multi-channel compound fault signal is obtained by mixing the single fault signal. Secondly, the FastICA algorithm is used to separate the compound fault signals, and the best estimated signal of the source signal is separated. After that, the fault type of each separated estimated signal is inferred by envelope analysis. Finally, Granger causality analysis was introduced to establish the causal relationship model between the compound fault signal and each estimated signal, and the composition of the compound fault signal was inferred to realize the compound fault diagnosis. The effectiveness of the compound fault diagnosis method is verified by the compound fault diagnosis experiment on the standard data set. The results show that the proposed method can correctly diagnose the compound fault type of rolling bearing, and has high diagnostic accuracy, which provides a new method for the compound fault diagnosis of rolling bearing.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Degradation Mechanism of A1GaN/GaN HEMTs Under the Effect of Microwave Pulses at Different Powers
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: We have investigated the effect of microwave pulse stress of different powers on A1GaN/GaN HEMTs. The dc characteristics of the devices were first scrutinized. The results indicate that the electrical characteristics of the devices are degraded after stress. The saturation drain-source current decreases from 681.8 mA to 246.5 mA, a decrease of 63.8 63.8%, at the power 40 dBm. And at the power 45 dBm, the saturation drain-source current drops even more, from 662.3 mA to 176.7 mA, a drop of 73.3 73.3%. The stress results in significant positive drift of threshold voltage and decrease of gate leakage current. And the degradation is more obvious with increasing microwave pulses power. Then, the internal defects of the device are characterized by low-frequency noise method, and the mechanism of device degradation is discussed. At the power of 45 dBm, the internal defect density of the device doubles, resulting in more electrons being captured at the channel. This is useful for the reliability level of future devices and practical applications.

articleTitle: A Physical-Assisted Multi-Source Signal Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Rolling bearings are essential for rotating machinery to withstand working loads. Bearing fault diagnosis is essential to avoid economic losses and accidents, but there are limitations to monitoring bearing condition directly from a single signal due to the presence of noise. In addition, many data-driven fault diagnosis methods rely exclusively on data and lack the integration of physical knowledge into the learning and prediction process. This paper presents a method for multi-source fault diagnosis of rolling bearings using current and vibration sensors. Signal features in the time and frequency domains are extracted and features containing physical knowledge are used as input to an XGBoost model by dividing the fault frequency sub-bands. The model was validated using a rolling bearing dataset from the University of Paderborn. An accuracy of 99.8% can be achieved, demonstrating the importance of multiple source signals and physical knowledge to improve diagnostic accuracy and confidence.

articleTitle: Inspection of Wire Ropes Based on Magnetic Flux Leakage Images by Using YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In industry, steel wire rope (SWR) is a key load-bearing component, the damage or breakage of which may cause serious safety accidents. Therefore, in order to avoid the breakage of SWR, it is necessary to carry out frequent SWR inspection and timely replace the SWR with potential problems. Magnetic flux leakage (MFL) detection is currently one of the most promising SWR detection technique. However, the existing MFL detection methods rely on model-based denoising methods and low-intelligence localization methods, when facing serious noise interference, the effectiveness of the existing methods can be affected. To solve this problem, a detection method based on MFL imaging algorithm and YOLOv5 network is proposed in this paper. The results show that the detection method proposed in this paper outperforms existing model-based detection methods, solving the problem of low detection accuracy under severe noise condition.

articleTitle: Simulated Data Driven GAN-Based for Fault Diagnosis Under Missing Fault Types
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) are often used to deal with the problem of sample data imbalance. However, traditional correlation algorithms may encounter problems regarding training stability or convergence difficulty. In addition, GANs can only generate existing fault samples, while it is likely that there is no corresponding fault sample data in practical engineering. To address this problem, this paper proposes a method based on a dynamical model with generative adversarial networks. A dynamics model is built to obtain the simulation signals of missing faults, and Wasserstein Auxiliary Classifier Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Normalization (WACGAN-GN) is used to supplement and generate the imbalance data. To verify the validity of the simulated samples, the enhanced dataset is classified using a stacked autoencoder (SAE). The results show that the model performs well in fault diagnosis under missing sample conditions and outperforms other methods.

articleTitle: Online Degradation Monitoring Method of PMSM Based on Stator Current
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The failure of driving motor can affect the safety of electric vehicles. This paper proposed a method on how to monitor health state based on the changes in stator current. A simulation model of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) was developed, which can simulate performance degradation. The stator current data were obtained through simulation by using fault injection under different states. The three indexes e.g. peak-to-peak, crest factor, and margin factor, of stator current were extracted, and the tolerance interval under the normal state was calculated. The simulation results show that the three indexes are all within the tolerance interval under normal condition. The degree of the monitoring indexes deviation from the tolerance interval is positively correlated with the degradation degree of motor. When the monitoring indexes are seriously deviated from the tolerance interval, fault warning should be given to avoid motor failures, and thus ensure safety of the electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Research on Data-Driven Integrated Environment Prediction Method for the Typical Cabin of Helicopter
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to accurately predict the microclimate environment induced in the cabin during helicopter parking, further support the design, verification and health monitoring of onboard equipment in the cabin. Based on the measured data of the natural environment and platform induced environment of a helicopter in the parking state, and considering the coupling change relationship between temperature, humidity and solar radiation, this paper proposed a comprehensive environmental synchronous prediction method of temperature, humidity and solar radiation intensity inside the helicopter cockpit and equipment cabin based on multiple linear regression and Elman neural network, and established a prediction model. It also predicted the cabin environment when it was serving in a certain place, and draws the high-temperature environment map. The results showed that the model had good prediction accuracy and could accurately characterize the relationship between the internal and external environment of the helicopter platform.

articleTitle: Domain Adaptive and Adversarial Transformer Networks for Fault Detection of Propulsion Shaft System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: During the actual navigation of the ship, fault samples obtained from the propulsion shaft system are scarce and not insufficient for data-driven method. Aiming at the above-mentioned challenges, this paper proposes a deep domain adaptive and adversarial transformer networks (DAATN) for cross equipment fault detection. The proposed method consists of transformer module (TM), condition classification module (CCM) and domain classification module (DCM). TM is used to extract high-level features from the input signal. The CCM is employed to diagnose the condition classes of the hidden features from TM, Meanwhile, the hidden features are fed into the DCM to learn domain invariant features. Furtherly, with the combination of domain adaptation and domain adversarial training in the model, the domain invariant features can be generalized from source domain to the target domain. Therefore, to verify the performance of method, the propulsion shaft system test stand is built to diagnose fault in the propulsion shaft system under actual operating conditions. The results show that the proposed method can achieve accurate detection while reducing the dependence on data-driven method on data from actual operating conditions.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Aircraft Power Generation System Based on ISSA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Addressing the challenge of dealing effectively with multiple variables and complex nonlinear relationships in aircraft power generation systems, which are typically difficult to handle using traditional linear methods, this paper presents an enhanced fault diagnosis method. The method combines the squirrel search algorithm and support vector machine (ISSA-SVM) to improve the accuracy of fault classification. The ISSA is enhanced by incorporating the periodic variational perturbation formula, optimizing the performance of the fault classification model. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, MATLAB/Simulink simulation experiments are performed using a fault dataset of the power generation system. The experimental results demonstrate that the diagnostic accuracy of the proposed method is significantly high.

articleTitle: Vague set-based fault tree analysis of automotive high-voltage relays
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In view of the difficulties in fault analysis caused by the lack of basic data on high-voltage relay events in electric vehicles, the vague set was introduced to quantify the bottom event failure probability. Apply the maximum and minimum AND gate fuzzy operators to calculate the top event failure probability and the importance of each bottom event. Finally, an application is made using an electric vehicle high-voltage relay sticking failure event as an example, and the results are compared with a fuzzy fault tree and a conventional fault tree analysis to verify the feasibility of the studied method.

articleTitle: Research on UFS Endurance Test and Life Prediction Method based on Back-Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Universal Flash Storage (UFS) is growing increasingly popular due to its high-speed performance and low power consumption, making it become a preferred choice for mobile devices, especially for high-bandwidth applications such as 5G networks and automotive applications. However, the repetitive program/erase (P/E) cycles and extreme temperature conditions could lead to degradation of devices. Error correction codes (ECC) could correct some memory errors, but uncorrectable errors would result in memory failure or incorrect data storage. Thus, for mitigating these problems, UFS manufacturers set conservative endurance specifications and adopt strict life management methods to ensure the reliability of their chips. Herein, this study aimed to investigate the impact of temperature and P/E cycles on the endurance of UFS devices by conducting endurance tests under different temperature conditions. Furthermore, we proposed a UFS lifetime prediction model based on Backpropagation neural network (BpNN) to predict the lifetime stages of devices from the lifetime characteristic data. The proposed model by our experiments achieved 94.5% accuracy on the test set, which can help users understand the performance of their devices and assist manufacturers to optimize the lifetime management methods for UFS chips.

articleTitle: Allocation Strategy for Operational Test of UAVs Based on Reconnaissance Mission Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The allocation strategy for operational test of reconnaissance UAVs should consider issues of target area division., allocation of UAVs., flight altitude., when anti-air defense and electromagnetic interference are taken into account. The proposed allocation strategy is based on achieving high mission reliability. So this paper first presents a mission reliability model for reconnaissance UAVs. Then, based on the reliability model, 9 UAV allocation plans are derived. Finally, under the constraints of target reliability and cost, the final solution is determined. The proposed model provides a new perspective of reconnaissance UAVs mission reliability., which is of great significance to the allocation strategy for operational test of UAVs.

articleTitle: Power Transformer Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Genetic Algorithm Optimized Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Dissolved gas analysis (DGA) of oil has become an effective means of transformer incipient fault diagnosis due to its ability to avoid the influence of complex electromagnetic fields and noise from the outside environment. However, the accuracy of transformer fault diagnosis based on DGA technology needs to be improved. This paper presents genetic algorithm (GA) employed to optimize random forest (RF) parameters to improve the accuracy of transformer fault diagnosis. Firstly, by comparisons of different DGA ratio selections, the non-code ratio method of dissolved gas in oil is determined as the input of the model. The number of RF base classifiers, the decision tree's maximum depth, and the number of features for decision tree node splitting are encoded into chromosomes using the binary method. The accuracy of RF is used as the fitness of individuals to establish the GA-RF model. The diagnostic performance of the model is verified using fault instance data. The results show that the diagnostic accuracy of GA-RF is the highest when the non-code ratio of DGA is used as the input of the model and the accuracy of the GA-RF model is significantly better than that of the support vector machine (SVM), decision tree (DT), RF, and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) models.

articleTitle: Research on Model-Based Reliability Verification Technique for Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Model-based reliability system engineering(MBRSE) is the current technical trend in the development of system engineering and reliability engineering technology, and it is an effective design assurance method to cope with the development assurance requirement of complex system products for civil aircraft. Aiming at the reliability verification problem in MBRSE for civil aircraft, the model-based reliability verification concept and process are proposed, the verification process of qualitative and quantitative reliability requirements based on model is analyzed, and the verification examples for failure condition occurrence probability of failure mode and effect analysis(FMEA) and function reliability assessment(FRA) based on model is given, it provides technological path for the practice of model-based reliability system engineering of civil aircraft, and points the way to work for the integration of MBRSE and MBSE of civil aircraft.

articleTitle: Rapid Evaluation Method of Dynamic Frequency Response of Power System With Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The large-scale random fluctuation of wind power connected to the power grid causes system frequency deviation, thereby affecting the safe and stable operation of the system. In order to study the influence of wind power fluctuation at different frequencies on the frequency deviation of the system, a frequency domain analysis model of power system frequency response including wind power considering generator characteristics, governor characteristics, system network structure and load characteristics is proposed. Based on this model, the display expression of the frequency response transfer function of each node of the power system under wind power excitation is derived. According to the amplitude-frequency characteristic performance of the transfer function, the frequency response characteristics of each node under the excitation of wind power fluctuations of different frequencies are accurately reflected. The model is applied to the 39-node system of IEEE10 machine, and the simulation is carried out based on the measured wind farm power fluctuation data, and the results show that the influence of wind power on the frequency response of each node of the system can be quickly and accurately evaluated by using the model.

articleTitle: Image Feature Driven Rolling Bearing Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method Based on DeiT
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: For the problems of existing rolling bearing intelligent fault diagnosis methods that insufficient information utilization, large amount of sample data, high training cost and insufficient data feature mining, an image feature driven rolling bearing intelligent fault diagnosis method was proposed based on Data-efficient image Transformers (DeiT) and synchronous squeezing transformation (SST). Firstly, SST is used to extract time-frequency image features of rolling bearing vibration signals, and a high fault discrimination image feature dataset can be obtained. Then, a fault recognition model is constructed based on DeiT, which regards the image feature data as input and ResNet18 as teacher network, and adopts hard distillation strategy for training. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method was verified using test data of rolling bearing faults. The results show that, compared with comparative methods, the proposed method can obtain higher fault classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Software Reliability Prediction Model Based on Improved Particle Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Software reliability evaluation can provide important reference for software quality evaluation and help developers to minimize software potential risks. This paper presents an improved particle filter algorithm to analyze software reliability. In the improved particle filter algorithm, Parzen window method is introduced first, which can smooth the data distribution and reflect the local features better. The weights of each particle are then adjusted using Bayesian estimation methods so that important particles get larger weights and unimportant particles get smaller weights. The improved particle filter can improve the prediction ability of the model under different conditions and improve the accuracy and reliability of the software reliability prediction.

articleTitle: The Study on Static Attribute of Tilting Pad Thrust Bearing with Thermal Elasto Hydrodynamic Lubrication Under Steady Load
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The model of thermal-elasto hydrodynamic lubrication is established in this paper. It applies Newton-Raphson and dichotomous method to iteratively solve the equations under steady load conditions to research the influence of thermal deformation on the static attribute of tilting pad thrust bearing. The consequences demonstrate that the thermal deformation boosted the dynamic pressure effect of the oil film. The maximum pressure will be magnified. Besides, the rotational speed is also a significant factor on the film thickness and temperature, which can weaken the impact of dynamic pressure. Therefore, in order to design and optimize thrust bearing, it is crucial to contemplate the material resistance to high temperature.

articleTitle: Fusing Distributed Extended Multi-Model Adaptive Estimation Method for Fault Diagnosis of Coupling Faults in a Liquid Rocket Engine
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In this paper, a fusing distributed extended multi-model adaptive estimation (FDEMMAE) fault detection and isolation (FDI) scheme is presented for FDI of coupling faults in a liquid rocket engine (LRE). Local extended multi-model adaptive estimation (EMMAE) models consisting of extended Kalman filters (EKF) are designed to describe the sensor failures in LRE subsystems, and the fusing weighted sum of squared residuals (FWSSR) of the LRE system is calculated based on filtering information of the local extended multi-model adaptive estimation (EMMAE) models, then a threshold test is employed to distinguish components failures with sensor failures of the LRE. Experimental results based on data from simulation are used to decorate the efficiency of the method. This study may help to improve LRE health management and reduce launch risk by solving the problem of coupling FDI of LRE with low computational consumption.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Vision Transformer for Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Gearbox with Limited Samples
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As a widely-used machinery and equipment in the industrial field, the health of gearboxes can have a direct or indirect impact on the production efficiency and effectiveness of downstream production workshops. Moreover, the failure of gearboxes can result in significant losses for equipment manufacturers. Therefore, accurate and efficient fault detection and diag-nosis methods are crucial. Traditional diagnostic methods like experienced-based observation, model-based diagnosis, or moni-toring signal analysis have certain limitations and are not always dependable to accurately detect the fault data's internal characteristics. With the development of deep learning, data-driven methods are now being used for the diagnosis of mechanical equipment. Currently, most studies use either Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) or Vision Transformer (VIT) or their variants and hybrid forms. CNN is adept at extracting local features while VIT emphasizes global information. Nevertheless, the weak bias induction ability of VIT has made it challenging to produce the same high-quality outcomes with large data sets when working with extremely limited data sets. To confront these intricacies, this paper proposes a self-supervised vision transformer (SSVIT) diagnostic model that improves the original VIT's inductive bias capability. This is achieved by incorporating a relative position density loss with the original cross-entropy loss. The gearbox dataset from Southeast University was employed to validate the model's efficacy in small-scale data sets containing just 50 fault samples. The results of five repeated experiments returned 100% efficiency. When compared to traditional machine learning models, original CNN and original VIT models, the proposed diagnostic model can still produce satisfactory out-comes even with limited samples.

articleTitle: Importance Analysis of Numerical Controlled Rotary Table Base on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Numerical controlled (NC) rotary table is a key component of numerical control machine tools. It is necessary to rank importance of each component, find the weak links, and then take maintenance measures to insure reliability. According to the working principle of the rotary table, one reliability model and one Bayesian network model were established. The probability of each node of the Bayesian network were calculated by using collected lifetime data. The weak link was identified by using the importance analysis method based on the Bayesian network. Then, the failure risk of each component was calculated and the optimal maintenance time is determined. The results show that the proposed method provides a feasibility technique for importance analysis of the rotary table.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Rotating Robot for Aeroengine Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aero engines typically use a borescope to detect damage inside the engine. This process relies on the inspector to observe the image and search for damage, and on an assistant to rotate the engine. This article proposes an automatic rotating robot for detecting the health status of aircraft engines. It can significantly improve the efficiency of aviation engine hole detection, reduce labor costs, and conveniently record and locate the position of damaged blades based on automatic rotating robots.

articleTitle: Sun Gear Fault Diagnosis of Helicopter Main Gearbox Based on Condition Indicators
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to improve the safety of the helicopter, selected appropriate condition indictors were used to diagnose sun gear faults of helicopter main gearbox, and the method was verified on the transmission system fault seeded test bench. The results show that values of condition indicators and health threshold calculated by the collected vibration data can be clearly distinguished, and crack faults and denudation faults of sun gear can be effectively diagnosed. It is concluded that the use of condition indicators to diagnose sun gear faults is effective.

articleTitle: An Improved Automatic Modulation Classification Method Based on Complex-Valued Capsule Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The modulation classification in communication systems is an essential technology in military and civilian domains requiring continuous updates and improvements. Furthermore, deep learning (DL) is widely acknowledged as an effective approach for Automatic Modulation Classification (AMC) and has been extensively applied in the field of pattern recognition. In image classification, capsule networks have shown excellent performance by encoding features and establishing relationships between parts and the whole in an image. However, the original capsule network is limited in its ability to extract useful feature information as it tends to contain all the information in the image, failing to leverage the advantages of capsule networks when faced with complex background datasets. In this paper, we propose a signal recognition architecture based on capsule networks and introduce a feature extraction block based on multi-channel and complex-valued networks to improve classification performance. Subsequently, we conduct comparative studies on different neural network models using the RadioML2016.04C dataset. Our results prove the outstanding results achieved by the proposed network in AMC. The proposed model outperforms other models by a 10% improvement in accuracy under low SNR conditions.

articleTitle: UAV Flight Data Anomaly Detection Based on Parameter Selection and Multiple Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are important in military and civilian applications. Flight data anomaly detection is an essential part of ensuring the safety and reliability of UAV s and has received extensive attention and research. The UAV system is complex and has many parameters. However, many unrelated parameters do not positively impact the model performance. In addition, since there are many anomaly types of UAV flight data, the adaptability of different anomaly types for anomaly detection methods remains a significant challenge. This paper proposes a data-driven method based on parameter selection and multiple regression for UAV flight data anomaly detection, which integrates correlation analysis and long short-term memory (CA-LSTM). First, a correlation-based analysis is performed to select parameters with correlation to reduce the model complexity. Second, an LSTM-based multiple regression model is designed to map flight parameters. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on real UAV flight data injected with two common anomaly types.

Author Keywords: correlation analysis and long short-term memory (CA-LSTM)

articleTitle: Ferrographic Wear Particle Identification of Marine Lubricating Oil Based on YOLO v5s and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Due to the friction side interaction of mechanical equipment, different types of wear can produce different wear particles, which contains a large numbers of important state information about the operation of the mechanical device. In this paper, the image of worn particles obtained from the detection of lubricating oils of mechanical equipment such as ship tail bearings and gearboxes are the object of the introduction of the Coordinate Attention (CA) mechanism with lightweight characteristics in the front of the SPPF of the YOLO v5s main roof network, which forms a YOLO V5s-CA model. Built with YOLO v5 detection software, the detection of grain images obtained by iron spectrum technology. Meanwhile, a variety of evaluation indicators and methods are used. The results showed that during the training process, the model's precision is 0.97, mAP is 0.99 and the convergence step is 32. In wear particle recognition, YOLO v5s-CA is superior to YOLO V5s in terms of reliability and leak detection. YOLO v5s-CA provides a new method for more accurate wear particle identification, which can accurately reverse the reasoning of the type of friction wear occurring in mechanical equipment, providing new methods for ship lubrication oil online monitoring and equipment failure diagnosis.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis and Optimization Design of Hot Carrier Injection Effect in Microcircuit System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: A bandgap reference circuit was simulated using Cadence Virtuoso-RelXpert to analyse the HCI effect, and the reason for its short overall lifetime was that the degradation rate of the two MOS tubes in the circuit was too fast. Therefore, the width and length of the two MOS transistors are increased by 2 times respectively, and the simulation results show that the overall life of the circuit is obviously increased. This shows that the method of increasing the width and length of the MOS tubes to reduce the degradation rate of the circuit is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Integration Test Method for Civil Aircraft Airborne Systems Based on Fault Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Reliability integration test is a kind of system integration tests which conducted on test benches such as iron bird to verify the safety and reliability design of civil aircraft airborne systems. It is necessary to inject faults into the tested airborne system through a fault injection system when conducting reliability integration test. By observing the status of the tested system and the changes in detection signals after injection of faults, and evaluating the impact of faults to verify the safety and reliability design of the airborne system. This paper studies the reliability integration test and fault injection technology of airborne systems, proposes a testing system and process for reliability integration testing based on fault injection. Through application cases, the operational methods and implementation effectiveness of the testing system and process were demonstrated.

articleTitle: State Tracking and Fault Diagnosis of Liquid Rocket Engine Based on Reduced-Order Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: This paper is aimed at the fault diagnosis of liquid rocket engine, especially in the case of deep thrust regulation scenario. After reducing the order of the model according to the actual sensor situation of the engine and using the state space expression, a new fault diagnosis algorithm is proposed based on the model. The algorithm is completely designed for the measurable parameters in the actual engine, which can avoid the complicated calculation of fault parameters in the previous research, and can accurately track the engine state when it performs a wide range of nonlinear thrust regulation. By applying the algorithm to engine simulation and test data, it proves the validity of the idea in this paper and the feasibility of its further optimization in the future.

articleTitle: Reliability Demonstration Test Design Method Based on Two-Stage Test with Zero Failure Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Reliability Demonstration Test (RDT) is the test to verify that the reliability of the product meets the reliability requirements during the product development and is usually required to be performed to determine whether it can be accepted. A traditional RDT is based on failure data obtained from tests during product development, to qualify product reliability. Due to advances in technology, many products are becoming highly reliable, which often results in few failures in development tests. So traditional methods are difficult to be applied to such cases where few failure data are available. In this paper, we provide an RDT design method for products following exponential distribution during two stages of development, combining the failure data of the previous stage with the zero-failure data of the second stage as the a priori information of the product lifetime by data folding method. Then Bayesian method is applied to obtain the lifetime distribution of the product to calculate risks of producer and user and to determine the RDT plan for the products restricted to the two risks. A case study is carried out to validate our proposed RDT design method for high reliability products, and to verify the feasibility of the proposed method by comparing it with the classical test method.

articleTitle: A Multi-Domain Feature Separability Analysis Method for Maritime Targets
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: To address the problem of multi-domain feature variation of multi-attitude targets in the background of sea clutter, the paper uses X-band radar to carry out data acquisition experiments of multi-attitude targets at sea, and analyzes the statistical features of multi-attitude targets in the time domain and frequency domain under low sea state, and defines the difference coefficients to analyze the difference of statistical features. The verification of a large amount of measured data shows that in low sea state, the statistical features of targets and sea clutter are different and have strong separability; the difference coefficients of the same statistical features between different attitude targets are between 0.0 and 0.1, which have small differences and no separability. These conclusions are of great significance for the data acquisition experiments of sea target characteristics and the optimized design of target identification methods.

articleTitle: Condition Monitoring of Wind Turbine Pitch System Based on Informer
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The pitch system is an important subsystem of a wind turbine (WT). Once it fails, the power generation efficiency of the wind turbine will be affected and the wind turbine will shutdown in serious cases. In this paper, a wind turbine pitch system condition monitoring model based on the Informer network is proposed using supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) information. Briefly, in data preprocessing stage, the key SCADA variables are selected by the operational state codes and correlation analysis to reduce interference. Then, the Informer model is constructed to predict wind turbine pitch system failures. Compared with the traditional time series prediction model, informer adds a self-attention mechanism, so the accuracy of the model is greatly improved. Real SCADA data from four wind turbines in southern China are used to demonstrate the better performance of the proposed method. Compared with LSTM and GRU, the prediction results of the proposed model show better performance.

articleTitle: Server Operational Status Recognition Based on Non-intrusive Energy Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As an important carrier for processing data, the stable operation of servers is related to the business continuity, productivity, data security, customer satisfaction, and the availability and convenience of personal services for enterprises. Aiming at the disadvantages of existing server operation status recognition algorithms such as poor practicality and complicated process of manual feature extraction, this paper proposes a method of using non-intrusive devices to collect the electrical energy consumption when the server is operating and combining with deep learning algorithms to achieve operation status recognition. The corresponding electrical energy consumption data are collected under different server operating status, and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network is designed to process and recognize the data with small computational volume and 100% accuracy.

articleTitle: Target Detection in Visible and Infrared Image Matching Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: By integrating visible light and infrared images, the efficiency of maritime target detection, recognition, and tracking is enhanced. However, some low-cost infrared devices lack focusing capability, preventing the acquisition of individual target images. Consequently, locating ships in corresponding visible light and infrared images becomes particularly critical. When utilizing YOLOv7 for ship target detection, issues of missed detection and low recognition rates for small targets arise. To address these challenges, this paper constructs a dataset comprising maritime target images captured in both visible light and infrared. Furthermore, an improved YOLOv7 model is proposed, involving the replacement of the activation function in the RepConv module with LeakyReLU to enhance network robustness. Additionally, a CBAM module is introduced after the Concat operation in the Neck section to boost network performance and enhance ship target feature representation. Experimental results demonstrate that the modified YOLOv7 model achieves a mAP of 94.18%, representing a 1.91% improvement over the original model. This validates the efficacy of the approach, further enhancing ship target detection performance and reducing missed detection rates.

articleTitle: In-Situ Health Monitoring of UAV Composite Propulsion Propeller Blades Based On a Flexible Sensing System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: For in-situ health monitoring for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) composite propulsion propeller blades, MEMS accelerometers are embedded inside the blades, and the vibration signals are acquired in real time using a flexible sensing system. Firstly, the validity of the signals acquired by MEMS accelerometers are verified by a shaker. Secondly, the comparison of the embedded-mounted sensor with surface-mounted sensor is performed. Moreover, in order to signal reduction and feature extraction for blade vibration, Teager energy operator (TEO) is applied to demodulate and enhance the pulse compositions, and singular value decomposition (SVD) is used to eliminate the random environmental noise. The experimental results show that the signals acquired by MEMS accelerometers and flexible sensing system can characterize the vibration of propeller blades. The combination of TEO and SVD effectively demodulates and highlights the characteristic frequencies while eliminating the noise.

articleTitle: An Improved LBG Clustering Algorithm Based on Bayesian Information Criterion
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Cluster analysis is an unsupervised classification method, which is the pretreatment part in data mining. And It is also the key to discovering unknown knowledge. However, the traditional clustering algorithm has some problems such as some algorithms need to predetermine k values, some algorithms can spontaneously search for k values but are not accurate enough and some algorithms can accurately search k values but the computational efficiency is too low. In order to solve the challenge of traditional clustering algorithm. An improved Linde-Buzo-Gray (LBG) clustering algorithm based on Bayesian information criterion was proposed. First, according to the traditional LBG thoughts to cluster and the rough value of k is obtained. After that the Bayesian information criterion was used to optimize each cluster and the exact k value was obtained. The theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the improved algorithm can search for the correct k value with high efficiency for clustering, which is more accurate than several traditional clustering methods.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Aviation Secondary Power Supply Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Timely and effective fault diagnosis for aviation secondary power supplies to minimize the failure rate and ensure the power supply of the load is critical. In this paper, in order to realize the fault diagnosis of aviation secondary power supply main topology phase shifted full bridge (PSFB) converter, the working principle, fault mechanism, mode, modelling method are studied. Based on the fault data analysis and feature extraction, the fault diagnosis is carried out by using support vector machine (SVM) algorithm, the results of which show that the methodology proposed in this paper has a high accuracy rate.

articleTitle: A Fault Simulation Analysis Method for Cross Level Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Based on the information of equipment usage scenarios, build a equipment level usage scenario model, analyze the operational requirements from the system equipment level to the system level, build a system level operation model, combine the system safety performance requirements, clarify the system fault criteria, integrate and build a system performance model, build a key component fault mechanism model, and conduct cross level comprehensive simulation and system fault simulation analysis, Observe the failure time of the system under different fault mechanism conditions.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Landing Gear Expert System Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The correct diagnosis of the fault degree of aircraft landing gear hydraulic retraction system can help pilots take timely actions to deal with different degrees of failure and avoid personnel and property losses. The purpose of this paper is to propose a kind of growing expert system based on past data by combining with neural network. This paper establishes the simulation model of a certain type of aircraft landing gear hydraulic retraction system and implants different degrees of fault, extracts fault data, normalizes the fault data and trains the corresponding neural network model. The expert system extracts the number of abnormal sensor in the fault data through the neural network, and compares it with the database in the expert system, so that the fault type of the aircraft landing gear hydraulic retraction system can be effectively diagnosed.

articleTitle: A Remaining Useful Lifetime Prediction Method based on Mixture Maximum Correntropy and Improved Unscented Particle Filter for Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Prediction of remaining useful life (RUL) provides a useful tool to guarantee the safety and health management of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs). In order to improve the prediction accuracy for long-term prediction, a new RUL prediction method (for short, MMCUPF- BiLSTM) is proposed based on the mixture maximum correntropy based unscented particle filter (MMC-UPF) and bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) for LIBs with various prediction terms. Firstly, the degradation model is trained iteratively by the MCC-UPF and the prediction errors for battery capacity are calculated. Then, the errors are reconstructed by using the complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) to remove the small fluctuations. Finally, using the error-correction mechanism, the multi-step-ahead RUL prediction results based on the trained model are corrected by predicted errors using the BiLSTM method. In the experiment, three LIBs are used to test the prediction accuracy for long-, medium-, and short-term predictions. The experimental results show that proposed MMCUPF-BiLSTM has much higher prediction accuracy and stable performance for different prediction terms and batteries.

articleTitle: Fault Prognostics of Elevator Door System Based on LSTM-GNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The elevator door system is an important part of the elevator, whose is prone to failure in operation. This paper proposes a method to predict the failure time of elevator door by monitoring the acoustic of door's opening and closing by combining long short-term memory network (LSTM) and graph neural network (GNN). Firstly, the collected acoustic signals will be extracted from the sound quality features and converted into graph datas with geometric structure to enrich the input information. Then abstract features in the dataset are extracted through multiple Graph Convolution (GConv) layers and pooling layers, and then these features are used as inputs to the LSTM, in turn the outputs of the LSTM are used as inputs to the fully-connected layer of the GNN, and the fully-connected layer output the final results. Using this method to process the experimental datas collected in the field, the possible time of failure can be predicted effectively. Finally, after comparing with other models, the superiority of the proposed one in this paper is fully proved.

articleTitle: WMCSCCNN Method for Intelligent Diagnosis of Transmission Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to overcome the disadvantage of missing information when using single-channel convolutional neural network for fault diagnosis, this paper combines image conversion method and multi-sensor data fusion technology to establish a new self-calibrated convolutional neural network model and apply it to the fault diagnosis of gearbox. Firstly, the vibration acceleration signals of multiple sensors are converted into gray images by image conversion method; Secondly, the self-calibrated convolution structure is introduced on the basis of the traditional multi-channel convolutional neural network to replace the traditional convolution layer to extract deeper feature information; Thirdly, the fusion layer is constructed by combining the multi-sensor fusion technology, and the correlation function weighting method is used to fuse the data collected by multi-sensors, which can adaptively fuse the feature information extracted from multiple channels; Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by using multiple sets of data on the planetary gearbox simulation fault test bench of our research group, and compared with other fault diagnosis methods. The experimental results show that the algorithm can achieve more than 90% fault recognition accuracy, and has a good fault diagnosis effect at different speeds, which is feasible for practical application.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Modeling and Simulation Method for Reliability and Testability Based on GSPN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In confront of the challenges posed by the rising complexity and integration of equipment, traditional methods for reliability and testability lack comprehensive descriptions, leading to redundant work. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes a collaborative modeling method for reliability and testability based on Generalized Stochastic Petri Nets (GSPN) and introduces a Monte Carlo-based simulation method for evaluating reliability and testability parameters. Finally, an application example involving an airborne antenna system is presented.

articleTitle: Research of Reliability Failure Prediction Method for Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Reliability of civil aircraft is one of the most concerned indicators by the industry, airlines and the public.Based on the current state and development trend of the aircraft system or equipment, the fault prediction can be carried out to predict the equipment that is about to break down, so the maintenance and aviation material standby work can be carried out in a planned way, so as to reduce the cost and waste and improve the reliability and economy of civil aircraft. In this paper, the research status of reliability fault prediction at home and abroad is analyzed, and the key factors affecting the reliability of airborne equipment are analyzed in combination with the actual engineering needs of the model development, so as to serve as the judgment basis for the potential failure of the analysis equipment. In addition, the reliability failure prediction modeling is developed based on the grey system theory.

articleTitle: Model Based Failure Assessment of Civil Aircraft Operation Phase
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Since its inception, MBSA has become increasingly mature and more suitable for complex civil aircraft systems. The elements of the model were defined and the model building was sorted out on the basis of current researches and the draft ARP4761A. The equipment level/ system level/ aircraft level models were establish based on Simulink. The external lighting sub-system of a certain aircraft model was taken as an example, and a numerical analysis was conducted on the operational data of a certain fleet. The result indicated that the failure of MBSA and FTA results lies within the acceptable range. The FMEA analysis was performed, and indicated that the probability of losing landing light function meets the safety requirements, with both the optimistic value (λlow) and the pessimistic value (λhigh) of equipment failure rate.

articleTitle: A GPQ Based Method for Reliability Assessment on Aircraft Hinge Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Mechanical duration on the bionic aircraft makes an important role in total lifetime and reliability. In our study, a complete degradation analysis aimed at flapping hinge mechanism is accomplished. Thanks to the convenience of software LMS Virtual Lab, we have achieved adaptive computation of virtual dynamic deduction under our random samples. Statistic inference is made afterwards under different assumptions of stochastic process so as to illustrate the influence from model selection. Three groups of parameters arel. collected based on GPQ method. The estimation to reliability and MTTF prediction of mechanism is eventually obtained.

articleTitle: Graph Model Based Positioning Entropy Feature Extraction for Early Change Detection of Rolling Bearings
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Abnormal changes in the early state of the rolling bearings usually appears weak and inapparent. To enhance the expression for bearing state, a graph model based on positioning entropy measurement is introduced into condition monitoring in this paper. First, the short-time Fourier transform (STFT) is adopted to convert the collected original signal into time-frequency domain, and then the power spectrum is generated by period-graph method for graph model construction to extract the relevant information hidden in the spectrum. The following process is extracted positioning entropy representing its structural changes from the model. Finally, a common hypothesis test based on the 3σ criterion is used for change decision making. We carry the experiments on the publicly available XJTU-SY data set, demonstrated its superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Reliability Simulation Test Method for Airborne Products with Integrated Software and Hardware
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Reliability simulation technology based on the physics of failure is more and more widely used in aerospace products, and its principle is to carry out failure prediction and damage analysis from the cause and mechanism of failure, so as to get the reliability indexes such as life distribution of each potential failure and mean time before failure. In this paper, we improve the reliability prediction method of electronic products based on failure physics from the nature of product failure, and consider software failure in the simulation process based on the characteristics of airborne products with integrated hardware and software, so as to improve the effectiveness of reliability simulation test.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Time Synchronization Device Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The time synchronization device can provide stable synchronization signal for the whole station equipment to ensure the synchronization performance of the whole station equipment. If there is a fault, the reliability of the whole system cannot be guaranteed. Therefore, the reliability of the newly developed time synchronization device needs to be evaluated. As a newly developed device, it cannot provide sufficient reliability analysis data, while BP neural network has good data prediction ability and the advantages of Bootstrap method in small sample expansion. The fusion algorithm based on BP neural network and Bootstrap method is established to realize the data expansion from small sample size to large sample size. The least squares linear fitting method is used to estimate the Weibull distribution parameters, which can effectively evaluate the reliability of the time synchronization device.

articleTitle: The Optimal Design of A Rotor System Supported by Squeeze Oil Film Damper
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Squeeze film damper(SFD) is damping devices which has been widely used in rotating machines. SFD can effectively suppress rotor vibration and reduce transmitted forces. However, it would cause complex motions of the rotor system under specific operating conditions. The influence of clearance of the SFD on dynamics behavior of the rotor-squeeze film damper system, such as critical speed, mode shape, vibration response has been developed in this paper. The Newton method was employed to optimize the vibration response. The results of optimization reduced the vibration amplitude of acceleration by 84<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and reduced the vibration amplitude of displacement by 86%. The contents and methods of this paper can provide guidance for the vibration optimization of rotor-squeeze film damper system.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Diagnosis Method for Planetary Gearbox Under Variable Speed Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the planetary gearbox fault signal under varying working conditions has the characteristics of multi-component modulation, non-stationary and weak features, which makes it difficult to extract the fault features, a novel planetary gearbox fault diagnosis method based on based on improved adaptive chirp mode decomposition (IACMD) and Maximum second-order cyclostationary blind deconvolution (CYCBD) is proposed. Firstly, the IACMD is used to decompose the non-stationary vibration signal, and the mode with the largest Gini index is selected as the sensitive component. Then, the selected sensitive modal component is resampled at equal angles to obtain angular domain signal. Finally, the CYCBD is used to enhance the weak fault features of the angular domain component, and the fault feature orders can be extracted from the envelope spectrum of deconvolution signal. The experimental results show that the proposed method can successfully extract the weak fault impact characteristics of planetary gearbox under varying working conditions, which verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Multiphysics Coupling Simulation for Electrostatic Sensing and Online Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: An aircraft engine is critical, and proper maintenance is highly recommended. Aero-engine failure diagnosis is based on condition-based monitoring, but the exhaust path parameters throughout the flight process are not used effectively. The exhaust of aircraft engine parameters are hot gases and particles of the unburnt fuel or erosion of the parts inside the engine. The electrostatic monitoring technology is extensively used for charge detection of exhaust particles. The problems faced by electrostatic sensing technology for effective fault analysis are the influence of the fluid flow parameters, position of the particles, and concentration of the particles. For this purpose, the Multiphysics coupling approach is proposed in this paper. The Multiphysics coupling scheme enables the investigation of the influence of these parameters on the electrostatic monitoring technology for fault monitoring of aero-engine. The Multiphysics coupling numerical Model of the aero-engine is developed with the optimal parameters of a probe-type electrostatic sensor. The COMSOL Multiphysics software is utilized for coupling flow field, heat transfer, particle tracing, and electrostatic physical parameters. The developed model is simulated at Mach number 0.3 for fluid flow parameters, and then ten particles of 10µm diameter are released randomly from the inlet. The position of particles shows that the particles are moving with the path followed by fluid flow parameters, and the output signal of the electrostatic sensor detects the charge created by the particles. Further, online fault monitoring by applying an electrostatic sensor was analyzed by adding a single particle with a higher diameter of 50µm. The addition of foreign particles increased the output voltage of the electrostatic sensor. This rapid change in the output signal of the electrostatic sensor confirmed the sensitivity of the developed model for fault monitoring of an aero-engine.

articleTitle: Degradation Modeling and Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Control Moment Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: With the rapid development of space technology and the increasing functions of spacecraft such as satellites and space stations, the requirements for pointing accuracy and attitude stability of satellites have increased. Therefore it is vital to develop large satellites with higher precision and stability in order to enhance the space strategic strength. Control moment gyroscope (CMG) is the key actuator of this kind of spacecraft, which can achieve accurate attitude control. So the quality monitoring and the remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of CMG is the main emphasis of spacecraft's Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). As for CMG, the degradation phase can be divided into multiple stages. This paper plans to use a method based on stochastic process model to predict the RUL of CMG. At first, the statistical process control (SPC) is used to divide the trend of CMG operation process and identify the time of stage change point. It is mainly divided into health stage and degradation stage, and a degradation Wiener process model is established for the degradation stage. Afterwards, the model parameters estimation and RUL prediction can be conducted. This paper uses the high-speed motor current (HSMC) data of a certain model for CMG to divide different stages and estimate the RUL. Then the working condition and residual life of CMG can be evaluated.

articleTitle: Three-Level Assessment of the Safety of Floating Nuclear Power Plants Under Hazard Waves
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In comparison to land-based nuclear facilities, floating nuclear power platforms situated at sea are frequently exposed to wave impacts, resulting in periodic oscillations of the platform. These oscillations have the potential to affect systems, equipment, and pipelines. Of greater concern are the more severe effects caused by high significant wave heights and the greater energy density of destructive waves, which directly impact the health and safety of the floating nuclear power station system. To address this, it is crucial to consider the impact of extreme ocean conditions caused by waves as a design basis accident, utilizing a deterministic evaluation approach. Therefore, this paper presents a three-level framework for analyzing the hazards of waves in the context of floating nuclear power platforms. It systematically evaluates the impact of wave hazards by considering three key aspects: statistical analysis of wave intensity and frequency in the sea area, hydrodynamic simulation of the floating nuclear power station, and assessment of system safety.

articleTitle: An Stepwise Approach for Degenerate Fault Data Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Balancing data in fault diagnosis poses challenges due to the rarity of failures caused by different working conditions and equipment. Generative models encounter reliability issues when generating long time series data. This paper proposes an algorithm for generating fault degradation data in a more reliable and controllable manner. The algorithm adopts a step-by-step approach, initially creating a smoothed version of the samples and subsequently generating fault samples with increased randomness. The effectiveness of the algorithm is evaluated using the C-MAPSS dataset, demonstrating improved stability in the training process and enhanced depiction of data degradation states. The introduced randomness improves the generalization ability of the diagnostic modeling process. The results indicate increased fault diagnosis accuracy and improved generalization capability. This algorithm effectively addresses the limitations of existing methods and provides a valuable solution for generating fault diagnosis data in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Four Point Contact Ball Bearings
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: This study focuses on the performance of bearings under different structural parameters and operating conditions. A four-point contact ball bearing model is constructed using a comparative calculation method to analyze the effects of bearing inner ring speed, number of balls, and external axial load variables. The mechanism of bearing performance changes is revealed, the influence of different operating conditions and structural parameters on the dynamic characteristics of bearings is clarified. The research results can provide guidance for the rational design of bearings to a certain extent, enabling them to achieve optimal performance. The research results found that the service life of the bearing is inversely proportional to the maximum contact stress of the inner and outer rings of the bearing. The maximum contact stress of the inner and outer rings can be reduced by adjusting other bearing structural parameters to achieve the best service conditions of the bearing. The purpose is to extend the service life of the bearing and achieve optimal dynamic performance under the conditions of meeting the normal operation of the bearing. This can be solved by adjusting the structural parameters or operating conditions of the bearing.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method for Rolling Bearings Based on Improved Morphological EMD Singular Value Entropy
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to make full use of the vibration signal for fault identification, a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on improved morphological ensemble empirical modal decomposition (EMD) singular value entropy is proposed. First, the rolling bearing vibration signal is pre-processed with Morphological Filtering (MF) to retain the useful signal. Secondly, EMD decomposes the signal to obtain several IMF components (Intrinsic Mode Functions, IMFs), selects the phase space reconstruction of IMF components for singular value decomposition, and combines with the information entropy algorithm to obtain the Singular Value Entropy (SVE) of fault characteristics; Finally, the type of rolling bearing failure is identified based on the variability of the entropy of the individual IMF singularities. The method described was validated using rolling bearing vibration signals from Western Reserve University. The results show that, compared with the traditional EMD singular value entropy fault feature extraction method, the method in this paper can extract effective fault features and can accurately identify rolling bearing fault states.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Rotating Machinery Based on Acoustic Field Signal and Domain Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Equipment to perform field tasks exist in high humidity, high temperature, high pressure, high corrosion and other equipment non-contact situation, the relevant accompanying security is not suitable for the installation of contact sensors to collect the state signal of the equipment, and field complex task profile equipment is often in a complex variable condition state. Therefore, it is necessary to use non-contact sensing means to obtain the state information of the equipment, and adopt monitoring, diagnosis and prediction methods applicable to complex variable working conditions to conduct online real-time evaluation and accurate diagnosis and prediction of the technical state and health status of the equipment. Based on this, an intelligent diagnosis method for rotating machinery based on acoustic field signal and domain adaptation is proposed. The method first uses wavelet transform to noise reduction of the sound field signal containing strong background noise, and obtains wavelet map. Then, the wavelet map features are extracted using residual neural network to achieve source-domain fault diagnosis. Also, the joint maximum mean difference is used to achieve migration diagnosis under different working conditions. This method can effectively solve the problem that traditional contact sensors cannot adapt to the complex environment and the variable operating conditions diagnosis in actual operation.

articleTitle: Secondary Voltage Control Strategy of Microgrid with Wind Power Based on Distributed Multi-Agent System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Microgrid is an effective means to achieve flexible management and control of distributed power sources. Compared with the traditional centralized secondary control mode, the distributed coordinated secondary control strategy has higher flexibility and reliability. A secondary voltage control strategy of isolated island microgrid for distributed multi-agent system is proposed. Think of distributed power as an agent in the system, and secondary voltage control is equivalent to the tracking synchronization problem of a multi-agent system. Based on linear state feedback, a distributed controller is designed, in which the output of the state estimator is used instead of the actual state of the system, and then the event trigger controller is used to update the system state. Using a certain communication network, each agent uses the information of local and adjacent agents to coordinate with each other to ensure that the voltage of the microgrid recovers the rated value, avoiding the dependence on the centralized controller. This control strategy allows agents to exchange information only at the moment of event triggering rather than continuous exchange in real time, reducing the amount of information exchanged for data and reducing the requirements for communication networks. The island microgrid test system was used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Active Learning Polynomial-Chaos Kriging Based Uncertainty Quantification and Reliability Analysis of a Spline-Shafting System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The flexible rotor system connected by a floating involute spline may experience self-excited vibrations due to internal friction excitation. The self-excited vibration induced by inevitable manufacturing tolerances, installation errors, component deformations, and other influencing factors exhibits significant uncertainty. In this study, we employ the active learning surrogate model to analyze the reliability of the nonlinear self-excited vibrations of the spline-shafting system. Firstly, considering the tooth surface friction, a nonlinear dynamic model of the rotor system is established for deterministic analysis of self-excited vibration response. Subsequently, considering the randomness of input parameters, Polynomial-Chaos Kriging (PCK) surrogate model is constructed to evaluate the failure probability of nonlinear self-excited vibrations in the rotor system under supercritical speed. The surrogate models are treated as black-box models, facilitating their combination with time-domain numerical integration and Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS), enabling rapid estimation of the relevant statistical information of self-excited vibrations. This approach contributes to the extension of applied research on uncertainty quantification and probabilistic reliability assessment for complex rotating machinery.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Control Moment Gyroscope Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The control moment gyroscope (CMG) plays the role of the actuator of the attitude control system in the spacecraft. Accurate and timely diagnosis of CMG faults is very important to ensure the normal operation of the spacecraft. Aiming at the problem of CMG fault diagnosis, a CMG fault diagnosis method based on random forest is proposed. By analyzing the principle of CMG fault diagnosis based on random forest algorithm, a fault diagnosis model of random forest algorithm is established, and the optimal number of decision trees of the model is found by cross-validation method. The optimal parameter is used to establish the final prediction model for fault diagnosis of CMG, and it is compared with the support vector machine (SVM) method. The results show that the random forest-based diagnosis method can effectively diagnose 6 fault types under various working conditions of CMG, and has higher accuracy and faster diagnosis speed than the SVM-based diagnosis method.

articleTitle: Vibration Analysis Based on Differential Evolution Mode Decomposition for Crack Identification of Helicopter Planetary Gearboxes
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As a core deceleration component of the transmission system, planetary gear trains' fault monitoring is crucial for helicopter flight safety. However, the complex and unique gear transmission structure causes vibration signals to exhibit extremely complicated signal forms. To address the problem of extracting fault features in a complex signal background, a Differential Evolution Variational Mode Decomposition (DEVMD) based method is proposed for monitoring the planetary gear train faults in helicopters. The method integrates the Overlapping Group Shrinkage (OGS) algorithm as a pre-filter to suppress background noise and combines the high-performance mode decomposition capability of DEVMD to strip out signal components from other rotating parts, obtaining planetary gear train fault-sensitive signal components. Finally, the higher-order differential energy kurtosis is extracted as a fault indicator for monitoring the planetary gear train faults in helicopters. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Multi-Stress Failure Characteristics of Space Station Power Tools Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As the Chinese space station continues its operations in orbit, The Extra-Vehicular Activity (EVA) power tools are increasingly facing a variety of complex working conditions when normalizing extravehicular operations. To gain a better understanding of the performance of EVA power tools in extravehicular operations, this study focuses on the motor components and designs an experimental system for multi-stress pulling offset. The system aims to investigate the impact of extreme conditions such as high/low temperatures, heavy loads, and high speeds in a vacuum environment on the working performance of motor components. The results indicate that increasing the set speed slightly enhances the output torque of motor components, while also significantly increasing torque fluctuations. Moreover, the operating temperature of motor components shows no strong correlation with stalling torque values. This experiment can be flexibly applied to various aerospace rotating products, providing valuable data support for future product design and improvement.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Technology of Slewing Platform Bearing Based on Multi-Channel Fused CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The Bearing with low speed and heavy-duty is a core component of the large rotary machinery equipment. It is very important for improving the safe service life of equipment to detect and diagnose faults in a timely manner, avoid under- and over-maintenance, and reduce financial losses. We construct fault simulation test bench for low-speed and heavy-duty bearing with six types of bearing faults. The location of the installation of the sensors was determined using finite element analysis software, and fault signals were collected at seven measurement points. By comparing the data input of single measurement point and multiple measurement points, as well as the different input modes of vibration signal and spectrum signal, it is finally determined to use the multi-channel fused convolutional neural network model with multi-point spectrum signal input, and the accuracy of fault diagnosis reaches 98.64%.

articleTitle: Dual-domain Signal Fusion Adversarial Network Based Vision Transformer for Cross-domain Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Many of the current fault diagnosis methods for intelligence rely on either a signal in the time domain or a signal in the frequency domain. However, frequency-domain signals often fail to fully capture the operational condition of bearings, despite their intuitive nature. On the other hand, time-domain signals contain valuable equipment status information, but their complexity poses challenges for learning by networks.
