articleTitle: Vibration Reduction Performance of a Periodic Mass-Spring Structure Carrying Multi-Type of Locally Resonant Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Periodic mass-spring structure carrying multi-type of locally resonant (LR) oscillators is developed to archive multiple low frequency LR band gaps and one wide high frequency Bragg band gap. Dynamic models of the periodic structure carrying LR oscillators or not are established. Transfer matrices of periodic elements in the structures are derived by using of transfer matrix method and the matrices are further used for computing wave propagation constants and velocity frequency response of semi-infinite and finite periodic structures. Effects of structural physical and geometrical parameters on band gaps and vibration attenuation performance of the periodic structures are analyzed numerically. Periodic isolator, which is periodic mass-spring structure carrying three-type of LR oscillators, is inserted into an isolation system to improve the vibration reduction performance of the system both in low and high frequency range. Numerical simulations reveal that multiple LR band gaps and one Bragg gap coexist in the periodic mass-spring structure carrying multi-type of LR oscillators; within frequency range of the band gaps, vibration transmitting through the periodic structure is substantially attenuated; compared to traditional vibration isolation system, better vibration reduction performance is achieved in the periodic isolation system in the band gaps.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Static Equipment for Oil and Gas Station Based on RBI
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Oil and gas are necessary factors to ensure the normal operation of society, and the safe production of oil and gas is also particularly important, and the risk assessment of static equipment in the station is extremely important. In order to develop accurate maintenance measures for the static equipment of oil and gas station, the RBI technology is introduced to analyze the risk of six core static equipment in this paper. Firstly, it is necessary to collect the relevant information of the station's static equipment. Secondly, the failure probabilities of static equipment can be calculated using the parameters of the same kind of failure probability, management system factor, and equipment correction factor. Then, the leakage mode is selected as a case, so the failure effect areas of static equipment can be also computed. Finally, a risk matrix is applied to determine the risk levels of static equipment.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries Via Hyperparameter Optimized Bi-Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) estimation of Lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) is essential to assess their long-term reliability. RUL can enable the prediction of LIB failure and thereby can mitigate operational risk. Machine deep-learning (MDL) models are popularly being trained on historical LIB capacity discharge data for RUL predictions by many research groups. Out of the variety of MDL methods, the Recurrent neural network (RNN) is being widely used to analyze LIB capacity discharge data; nevertheless, RNN is inadequate in learning the long-term dependencies, which limits its usage for the prediction of RUL. Therefore, this work investigates Recurrent Neural Network (Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory) RNN (Bi-LSTMs) for the prediction of RUL. Here, RNN with forward and backward long short-term memory (Bi-LSTMs) is applied to realize both forward and backward long-term dependencies of LIB capacity discharge data and then construct a discharge capacity-based RUL predictor. Raw, unaltered (to capture intricacies, and variations in real-world data) multiple LIBs capacity discharge data are deployed for RNN (Bi-LSTMs) training and validation. Further, optimal hyperparameters for RNN (Bi-LSTMs) are obtained through Bayesian optimization. Optuna, an open-source Python library, is used for hyperparameter optimization using a hyperparameter search space. Therefore, the whole training process is automated with only inputs required including LIB capacity discharge data and hyperparameters search space. As no manual entry of hyperparameters is required, the model has the ability to be trained with any available LIB capacity discharge data. Furthermore, the RNN (Bi-LSTMs) demonstrated competency in predicting capacity discharge characteristics and provided good estimations of the RUL with %error in predicted RUL with respect to the experimental true RUL as low as 14.3%.

articleTitle: A Deep Generative Digital Twin for Vehicle Steering System Health Monitoring with Limited Healthy Monitoring Samples*
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The intelligent health management for vehicle steering system often faces problems like history data dependency and limited faulty samples. Digital twins (DT) have the potential to solve these problems. However, the advantages of DT might be lost due to the prior physics knowledge, data heterogeneity, and the limited healthy physical samples. In this paper, the Weighted Feature Space Measure Barycenter Averaging-Wasserstein Generative Digital Twin architecture (WFSMBA-WGDT) is proposed. The WFSMBA algorithm is designed through a designed low-dimension feature space measure to synthesize samples whose distributions are similar to healthy physical samples efficiently. The WGDT is constructed combining the Wasserstein generative adversarial network with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) trained with the synthetic samples and the proposed consistency test. This test can guarantee the high fidelity of the virtual samples without large time consumption and prior knowledge. Afterwards, the WFSMBA-WGDT can be used to carry out multiple health management tasks. The effectiveness of the WFSMBA-WGDT is verified through case studies.

articleTitle: An Unified Nonconvex Sparse Decomposition Method for Fault Feature Enhancement of Rotating Machinery
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of early weak fault feature extraction of rotating machinery under strong noise interferences, an unified nonconvex sparse decomposition (UNSD) method is proposed for the weak fault feature enhancement in this paper. By introducing a reweighted strategy and L2 norm regularization into the traditional generalized minimax-concave (GMC) model, the proposed UNSD method can overcome the amplitude attenuation and overfitting problems to strengthen the stability of the iterative process. The convexity condition of the cost function in our UNSD model is theoretically derived and the optimization algorithm is developed with the forward-backward splitting (FBS) algorithm. Meanwhile, two Fitness functions are customized to optimize the key model parameters via the genetic algorithm and evaluate the decomposition performance of our UNSD model. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed algorithm have been successfully confirmed in comparison with state-of-the-art approaches through both the simulation study and experiment validations.

articleTitle: Reliability Modelling Method Based on The Stepwise Refined Performance Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Reliability modelling based on product performance is a hot issue in recent years. Since the relationships between performance and numerous influencing factors are greatly terribly complex, surrogate model with experimental designs has received wide attention. However, due to the limitations of experimental capabilities and conditions, it is difficult to control and measure all the variables in a set of experiments. Hence, it is often difficult to balance the generality, significance and accuracy in one single model. To overcome these issues, in this paper, a stepwise refined performance surrogate model (SRPSM) is proposed. Further, by introducing the concept of performance margin in belief reliability theory, a novel reliability modeling method based on SRPSM is developed. To illustrate the proposed method, the reliability model building process of a new electrical connector product is shown as an example.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Degradation Modeling and Remaining Useful Life Prediction Method Based on Uncertain Random Process
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is the foundation and core of prognosis and health management to improve the reliability of the device. For a category of devices with two-stage degradation characteristics, the aleatory and epistemic uncertainty caused by inherent fluctuations within the system and insufficient sample knowledge is ignored frequently. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel two-stage degradation model and RUL prediction method considering aleatory and epistemic uncertainty. Firstly, a two-stage uncertain random process is established to characterize the degradation trajectory of the device, and the analytical expression of the RUL is derived under the concept of the first hitting time. Afterwards, the modified information criterion is employed to detect the change-point. Meanwhile, the stochastic uncertainty maximum likelihood estimation algorithm and Bayesian update are used to achieve parameter identification. Finally, the practicability of the proposed method is verified by Monte Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on Deep Residual Network and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Bearings as the key component of a rotating machinery, their health affects the operation of the entire rotating machinery. Effective and accurate bearing fault diagnosis can ensure the safety of machinery operation and reduce maintenance costs. Nowadays, more and more bearing fault diagnosis methods are developed based on deep learning (DL) network. Although great progresses have been made from the DL-based methods, the diagnosis results highly rely on expert experience and manual hyperparameter settings. To solve such an issue, this paper proposes a bearing fault diagnosis method based on deep residual network (ResNet) and particle swarm optimization (PSO), the proposed method is named as ResNet-PSO-based bearing fault diagnosis method. In the proposed method, ResNet is used to improve the diagnosis accuracy, and PSO is adopted to automatically optimize the hyperparameters in ResNet. The effectiveness of the proposed ResNet-PSO-based bearing fault diagnosis method is validated on the bearing dataset from Paderborn Bearing Data Center. Some state-of-the-art methods are compared, and the results show the outperformance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Health Indicators Correlated to Battery State of Health Estimation: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Accurate state of health (SOH) estimation plays a fundamental role in battery reliable operation. Recent research has achieved outstanding results on SOH estimation by extracting various health indicators (HIs) and developing advanced algorithms. Several studies have summarized the SOH estimation methods from the modelling perspective. This paper reviews the recent studies focusing on the utilization of different HIs. Including the commonly used charging/discharging curves, impedance, and advanced sensing technologies. Their advantages and limitations are analyzed from implementation and practical application. We also outlook the future research directions of deep learning applications and the requirement of sensing methods.

articleTitle: A Transformer-CNN Based Transferable Model for State-of-Health Prediction of Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: With the rapid development of electronic devices, the prediction of the lithium batteries’ state-of-health (SOH) has become more and more important. Correct maintenance measures could be taken by users with the support of an accurate SOH prediction to ensure the normal operation of the devices and minimize the cost. Therefore, this paper establishes a transferable Transformer-CNN SOH prediction model, which can effectively extract temporal features and achieve good prediction results for data with different distributions. Through extensive experiments on NASA and CACLE lithium batteries datasets and comparisons with other deep learning network models, we verified that our model is able to better handle the SOH prediction problem and can effectively extract the temporal features. Meanwhile, we used different numbers of encoder and decoder layers for model construction to obtain the model structure with the best prediction performance. The experimental results show that our model can effectively handle time-series data and can achieve cross-domain prediction of lithium batteries’ SOH.

articleTitle: Cross-Device Anomaly Detection of Health Status for Industrial Robot Joints Based on SWDCGAN-Deep CORAL
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As a key manufacturing element, industrial robots have been widely used in various industrial manufacturing companies to improve production efficiency. However, it is hard to detect the abnormal health status of an operating industrial robot when there are insufficient anomaly samples and cross-device detection has to be encountered. To solve such issues, an anomaly detection method of health status for industrial robot joints is proposed in this paper. The proposed anomaly detection method is based on Sliding Window-Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network- Correlation Alignment for Deep Domain Adaptation (SWDCGAN-deep CORAL), which contains two modules: sample enrichment module and anomaly detection module. In the sample enrichment module, SWDCGAN is used to enlarge the sample amount and balance the number of samples with normal and anomaly labels. In the anomaly detection module, deep CORAL measures the differences of collected signal distributions of industrial robot joints from different devices, meanwhile is used as the feature extractor. The proposed method is validated on the dataset of different industrial robots under accelerated life tests. Besides, the validation results show the outperformance of the proposed methods compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Fault Diagnosis Method Using Weight-Based Mask Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) methods are usually employed to improve the generalization capability on diagnosing the monitoring data under different operating conditions, alleviating the requirement of machine learning methods for data to obey the independent and identically distributed assumption. However, traditional UDA methods always suffer from the following two problems. 1) The classifier is trained only on labeled fault data from the source domain, leading to a bias toward excessively learning from the source domain data. 2) The foreground information that is relevant to the class during the domain alignment process, fails to be obtained in an effective way. To address these two problems, a novel transfer diagnostic method using a weight-based masked network, consisting of the Domain Ignorance Module (DIM) and the Semantic Enhancement Module (SEM), is proposed in this paper. The DIM can reduce the impact of domain-related information on the classifier and promote the classifier to pay more attention to the common fault features between different domains. And the SEM enhances the class-related information in the features, allowing the network to effectively utilize foreground information during the domain alignment process. It is noteworthy that the two modules can be seamlessly incorporated into the structures of many UDA methods like domain adversarial neural network (DANN). Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is assessed through the evaluation of 24 transfer diagnostic tasks sourced from two distinct datasets and compared with six state-of-the-art UDA methods. The experimental outcomes conclusively indicate that the proposed method attains the highest level of diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on RepVGG Migration Diagnosis Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Given the shortcomings of existing deep learning methods in rolling bearing fault diagnosis, such as a large number of training parameters and complex network, a lightweight neural network-migration diagnosis network model based on RepVGG is proposed. First of all, the vibration signal is converted into a three-channel time-frequency image by the combination of short-time Fourier transform (STFT) and pseudo-color processing technology. Then the RepVGG model trained on the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) data set is taken as the pre-training model, and the methods of intermediate working conditions and small sample migration are introduced and applied to bearing fault diagnosis under other working conditions. the experimental results show that the algorithm has the advantages of fast training speed, high generalization, and high accuracy. Finally, the open source framework ncnn is used to deploy the model to the edge platform Raspberry Pi. The experimental results show that the edge calculation module can effectively diagnose bearing faults and is a qualified motor-bearing fault diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Network Reliability Analysis of VHF Data Exchange System Base on Improved Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: This paper uses the improved complex network theory to analyze the real-time reliability of the VHF data exchange system (VDES). Firstly, the improved complex network theory was designed to capture the information exchange process between subsystems and the interaction between subsystems and their components. Then, the models under different scenarios and various system failures were established. Finally, this research finds the weak link of the VDES complex network, studies the changes in the relevant parameters of each complex network under node failure and edge failure, identifies the importance of modules, and provides information for decision-makers

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of Anti-SEU Computer System with Timed Refresh and Backup Fault Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Spacecraft often fail due to single event upset (SEU) events. To enhance system reliability, a variety of anti-radiation reinforcement measures are used in combination. This paper proposes a reliability assessment method for a computer system that adopts timed refresh and backup fault tolerant measures. This method establishes a failure probability model for the SEU-prone RAM devices in computer systems by considering the state transition characteristics of the timed refresh task and the error correction rules of Hamming codes. Additionally, the Bootstrap small sample data processing method is utilized to obtain the confidence interval estimation of the failure probability. Furthermore, a dynamic fault tree is established according to various backup measures and logical architectures of the anti-SEU computer system. The reliability of the system during the mission is estimated using the Monte Carlo method. At the end of the paper, a case study is carried out. The reliability data of components or systems obtained by this method will provide a reference for designers to evaluate whether the spacecraft is operating safely in orbit.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Canonical Correlation Analysis Network for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Rolling Bearings
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Rolling bearings play a vital role as critical components of rotating machinery in various industries. Accurately predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) of bearings is essential to enable predictive maintenance practices. Most of the existing prediction methods input the original multi-sensor vibration signals directly into the deep learning model for training and ignore the correlation information between different channels, which will limit the precision of prediction. To overcome this challenge, we develop a Multi-level Canonical Correlation Analysis Network (MLCCAN) for bearing degradation feature extraction and RUL prediction. The proposed approach is based on wavelet packet decomposition (WPD) with attention mechanism, spatial-temporal feature learning, and the canonical correlation analysis (CCA) method. A spatial-temporal feature learning block is designed to extract sensitive feature representation and a CCA loss function is constructed to constrain the correlation between the multi-level features. Experimental results on a public bearing dataset validate the effectiveness and superiority of our proposed model in predicting the RUL of bearings.

articleTitle: A Continual Learning Framework with Adaptive Synapses for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is an important part of machinery prognostics health management (PHM). Deep learning-based RUL prediction methods of machinery have attracted increasing attention in recent years. As a data-driven approach, deep learning-based RUL prediction requires a large amount of whole life cycle data to train the deep network; however, the extremely long cycle of obtaining machinery run-to-failure data makes it difficult to obtain enough data in a short period, which hampers the engineering application of deep learning-based RUL prediction. To solve this problem, an adaptive synapse constituted hybrid convolutional network is proposed. Firstly, the basic building blocks of neural networks called adaptive synapses were developed that can adaptively control synaptic activity to enable the network to perform elastic continual learning. Then, a hybrid convolutional layer is designed so that the prognostics network can continuously learn from monitoring data with different operating conditions. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated through accelerated degradation tests of bearings. The experimental results show that the proposed method is effective and superior to the existing methods in the continual learning RUL prediction of machinery.

articleTitle: A Joint Optimization Policy of Tail Assignment and Maintenance Scheme for Civil Aircraft Fleet
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: This study aims to improve the collaborative administration of operations and maintenance for civil aircraft fleet. To overcome the challenge of simultaneously considering the flight path and maintenance requirement, a modified connection network framework is developed by innovatively introducing the maintenance opportunity node. Based on the network construction, an integer programming model is formulated for the collaborative optimization of tail assignment and maintenance scheduling. To tackle the large scale of this problem, a problem decomposition-based two-stage solution process is presented, which is composed of the maintenance opportunity-oriented tail assignment optimization and the reasonable maintenance task allocation procedure. Compared to the traditional manually scheduled letter check mode, our work could efficiently output the cost-effective joint scheme of tail assignment and maintenance task allocation for airlines.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Study of a Triple-Coils Wear Debris Inductance Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Simulation optimization and experimental study of a triple-coils inductive oil wear debris sensor to achieve effective monitoring of wear debris. To address the problems of low monitoring sensitivity and high false alarm rate in the practical application of metal chip end sensors, firstly, a mathematical model of the output induced electric potential is established based on the detection principle of three-coil inductive sensors. Secondly, a simulation model is constructed based on the influencing factors in the mathematical model to provide a basis for optimizing the coil structure. Finally, the inductive sensor is fabricated according to the actual oil flow pipe diameter and flow rate, and an experimental platform is built in the laboratory environment for testing. The output sensing signal is demodulated using an envelope detector algorithm, and an outlier point detection method based on the “3sigma” rule is used to identify abrasive debris. Experimental results have demonstrated that the triple-coils inductive oil wear debris sensor achieves the identification of 2mm abrasive particles within the constraints of the oil line diameter.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method of Harmonic Reducers Based on Markov Field Graphs and Graphormer
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Harmonic reducers(HRs) are the core components of industrial robots, and their states of healthy states directly affect the execution and positioning accuracy of the robots. Due to their high frequency of use under heavy loads, they are prone to various faults. In this paper, a new method for fault diagnosis of the HRs was proposed, combining the symmetric normal distribution maximum Markov field with Graphormer, wherein, the Markov field was used to transform vibration signals into graph information, the maximum values of symmetric normal distribution were used as the quantization indicator to enhance the feature similarity between samples, and the Graphformer was used to extract features related to fault status in graph information. Comprehensive experimental results showed that the proposed method improved accuracy by 17.8% in average over other four GNN-based methods, indicating its great potential as a generic fault diagnosis method for the HRs.

articleTitle: A Novel ResMTN-Based Methodology for HVAC AHU Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The Backpropagation Multidimensional Taylor Network (BP-MTN) classifier improved based on MTN may face issues such as overfitting and gradient vanishing when solving complex classification problems. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel classifier, the Residual Multidimensional Taylor Network (ResMTN) classifier. The classifier introduces the idea of Residual Network (ResNet) in the MTN, by adding a direct connection between the input and the fully connected layer beside the polynomial layer of the MTN, that is, using the skip connection to skip the polynomial layer, thus improving the generalization ability of ResMTN. In addition, in order to improve the parameter learning ability of ResMTN, this paper uses the Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) algorithm for parameter estimation to improve the stability of training and learning effect. In experiments, we use the ASHRAE RP-1312 public dataset to verify the performance of the proposed ResMTN-based fault diagnosis method for air handling units. Experimental results show that ResMTN has higher average accuracy than some other existing methods, and the training time of the model is relatively short.

Author Keywords: Heating ventilation and air conditioning system

articleTitle: Intelligent diagnosis approach for the critical structural part based on FSDP figure and DCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: With the increasing application of UAV, the corresponding means of support also need to keep pace with the times. With the large-scale development of artificial intelligence, the combination of fault diagnosis and artificial intelligence provides an important opportunity for the leapfrog development of key technologies of UAV support, and also provides an important opportunity for the improvement of the level of UAV safety and operation reliability. Based on the ultrasonic signal analysis method in structural health monitoring, this paper carries out research on the damage detection of key structural components of UAV landing gear, and combines the deep learning model to intelligently detect the damage of structural components to improve the detection efficiency and accuracy. Aiming at the characteristics of nonlinear damage signals in structural health monitoring, the feature extraction method of Frequency Symmetrized Dot Pattern (FSDP) is proposed. On this basis, an intelligent damage detection method based on FSDP feature and DCNN is proposed. The structural damage simulation and detection experiments are carried out in the landing gear experimental environment, and the effectiveness of the proposed intelligent detection method is verified by experimental data.

articleTitle: PB-YOLO for Railway Fastener Detection: A Higher Accuracy and Lightweight Model With PConv and BiFPN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The safety status of railway track components is of paramount importance for ensuring railway transportation security. UAV imagery based fastener status monitoring is an effective alternative to manual inspection. YOLOv7 has demonstrated outstanding performance in the field of object detection and has been widely used for detecting abnormal conditions in railway scenarios. However, the deep layers of the network have led to a large number of parameters, resulting in a slowdown in inference speed. Jierun Chen et al. proposed a new partial convolution (PConv) to achieve a faster network structure, which efficiently extracts features by reducing redundant computations and memory access simultaneously. Taking inspiration from this, we propose a new single-stage detector called PB-YOLO for faster inspection. Firstly, we create a new efficient aggregation-based network with PConv called CPC to replace the original ELAN structure. Secondly, in the feature fusion network, we design a repeatable bidirectional cross-scale path aggregation module, which dynamically fuses features and facilitates information exchange, enabling the network to handle the features having different scales and semantic levels for improving detection accuracy. Finally, experiments conducted on the customized track dataset UAV2022 show. PB-YOLO achieves excellent performance with an average precision (mAP) of 96.7%, and reduces the parameter count by 8% and GFLOPS by 20%. The ablation experiment verified the effectiveness of each module of PB-YOLO.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction for DC-DC Power Converters Based on Sample Entropy and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As an important component of the power supply system in industrial production, the power converters often operate continuously under high thermal and electrical stress for a long time. Once severe degradation occurs, it will affect the production efficiency and product quality of the entire assembly line. Therefore, in order to improve the reliability and availability of power converters, a fault prediction method based on a combination of time series signal decomposition and deep learning is proposed in this article, which can address the problem of low prediction accuracy caused by the nonlinear trend of circuit performance degradation. Firstly, the performance degradation test platform was built for power converters under thermal stress and energized working modes, while the output voltage is collected at regular intervals. Afterwards, the output voltage signal should be preprocessed and the sample entropy is used as its fault feature parameter. Then, the sample entropy time series are decomposed by CEEMDAN to extract the monotonic trend component. Finally, the fault prediction has been completed by each decomposed component using LSTM algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed method obtains high prediction accuracy which verity its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Fault Feature Learning Model for Zero-Shot Intelligent Diagnosis of Compound Faults in Rotating Machinery
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Due to the intricacy of rotating machinery and the interconnections among its systems, diagnosing compound faults in equipment poses a major challenge in this research area. Existing intelligent compound fault diagnosis methods rely on having sufficient compound fault data for training. However, obtaining complete compound fault data in industrial scenarios is an arduous task, and compound faults are often considered as unknown faults. This paper introduces a zero-shot intelligent diagnosis model that focuses on discriminating unknown compound faults. The method comprises four stages: data acquisition and preparation, fault features learning, fault semantics construction, and feature semantics mapping. Our primary focus is on the feature learning stage. The fault feature learning model of the zero-shot intelligent diagnosis method (FFL-ZID) incorporates a feature-level contraction block and a decision-level contraction block. The former filters valid information to extract essential features from the raw data, while the latter promotes feature decoupling to ensure independence among selected features and reduce redundancy. Experimental results on the mechanical comprehensive diagnostic simulation platform (MCDSP) demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for identifying unknown compound faults in rotating machinery.

articleTitle: An Uncertain Operational Risk-Oriented Approach for Manufacturing System Functional Failure Prognosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As the functional output of manufacturing systems, workpiece quality is the key objective for manufacturers to assure and enhance system health. Despite extensive studies, a key setback, i.e., lacking a feasible solution to handle the issue of uncertainty associated with 5M1E factors (i.e., Men, Machine, Material, Method, Measurement, and Environment) in the sense of risk modeling, still exists in the study of manufacturing system prognosis and health management (PHM) technologies. Correspondingly, an operational risk-oriented approach to predict functional failure for manufacturing systems is proposed. Based on a conceptual investigation of manufacturing system operational risk and functional failure in terms of 5M1E uncertainty, this study (i) applies a fuzzy Markov-based functional degradation model to characterize the uncertainties of the functional degradation process, and (ii) proposes the functional failure prognosis model considering explicit and implicit operational risk. As validation, an industrial case study based on an aero-engine cylinder head manufacturing system is conducted. The result demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method to predict the occurrence of functional failure and thereby eliminate operational risk.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Under Variable Working Conditions Based on EOS-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Under time-varying working conditions, the vibration signals of rolling bearings have problems such as amplitude changes, pulsating impact intervals, non-constant sampling phase, and signal noise pollution. These factors making it difficult for data-driven methods to learn the feature information of the signals and achieve intelligent diagnosis of rolling bearings under variable working conditions. To address this issue, a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on envelope order spectrum and convolutional neural network (EOS-CNN) is proposed in this paper. First, an improved variational mode decomposition (VMD) method is used to decompose the original signal to obtain the optimal Intrinsic mode functions (IMFs). Then, the EOS features of IMFs are extracted using the Hilbert order transform (HOT). Finally, a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D CNN)-based classifier is employed to classify the extracted features and achieve intelligent diagnosis of rolling bearing faults. The proposed method is verified by publicly available variable speed bearing dataset from Ottawa University. The experiments results show that the diagnostic accuracy of the proposed method with envelope order analysis-based fault features as input is much higher than that of the original signal as input, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Ground PHM Principled Sample Machine for Airborne Fuel Pump Based on Three-Dimensional Multiphase Criterion
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In response to the problems of massive heterogeneous data, complex structural hierarchy, and inefficient functional implementation in the design of the ground PHM principled sample machine for airborne fuel pump, based on the three-dimensional multiphase criterion of the PHM system, and guided by the implementation of the PHM function of the airborne fuel pump, analyze the technical route of the design of the ground PHM principled sample machine for airborne fuel pump from three aspects, the modeling design method of the MBSE based airborne fuel pump PHM system, the visualization of PHM system design elements based on knowledge graph, and the real-time optimization based on software and hardware collaborative acceleration. The ground PHM principled sample machine for airborne fuel pump is designed to achieve real-time fault diagnosis and degradation prediction functions of the airborne fuel pump. Through the collaborative optimization design of software and hardware, the accuracy of the calculation results is ensured while achieving 26.32 times acceleration calculation. Provide a systematic reference solution for the engineering application of aircraft PHM system.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method Based On Joint Distributional Adaptation For Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Under Different Working Conditions With Imbalanced Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Rotating parts are the heart of the machinery industry, so various industries put forward higher requirements for the stability and reliability of mechanical work. However, relying on manual fault diagnosis is not only time-consuming and laborious, but also the accuracy rate is not ideal, so machine learning was introduced to the machinery fault diagnosis industry, but the training of fault diagnosis models depends on a large amount of data, and the working conditions of mechanical faults are variable, and it is difficult to apply the model trained under one working condition to another working condition. Therefore, we introduce the domain adaptive method of migration learning in fault diagnosis. However, most of the samples in real production are normal samples, and fault samples only account for a few. The sample imbalance problem needs to be solved urgently, so we adopt the method based on joint distribution adaptation, which firstly uses the model itself to make a priori judgment, and learns on the basis of the judgment; moreover, in order to solve the problem of ignoring the small samples and weight bias when the model samples are imbalanced, we propose the inverse sparsity loss function and entropy increasing loss function. Under the operating conditions of the bearing sample imbalance variable, fault tests are designed to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method to solve the sample imbalance problem.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Vibration Characterization of Cracked Rotor Based on Breathing Crack Function
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The application of mathematical language to the periodic description of the change process of the breathing crack can more effectively restore the influence of the breathing crack on the vibration characteristics of the rotor. In this paper, the crack of the fixed structure rotor is parameterized, and a finite element mathematical model of the transverse breathing straight crack rotor is established based on the breathing crack function, and the finite element dynamics equations are deduced. The vibration characteristics of the rotor were analyzed by the harmonic balance method combined with specific boundary conditions, and the amplitude-frequency response characteristics of the rotor were extracted for different crack locations with different breathing crack depths. And through the cracked rotor dynamics test with known crack parameters, the frequency domain diagrams in transient state and the axial trajectory diagrams in steady state were obtained, which were compared with the theoretical calculation results in the previous paper to verify the validity of the constructed model. The results show that as the crack location approaches the rotor, the deeper the crack depth is, the more drastic is the decrease of the rotor first-order critical speed. The rotor system containing breathing cracks shows strong nonlinear characteristics, with more obvious displacement fluctuations at both 1/2 times the critical speed and 1/3 times the corresponding frequency of the critical speed.

articleTitle: Techno-economic Risk Analysis for Onboard Hydrogen Storage by Quantitative Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: There are still safety concerns to use hydrogen as energy storage for commercial applications in a safe, efficient and cost-effective way. This paper is dedicated to discussion on safety improvement of hydrogen storage equipment for onboard applications. It provides a brief review, and then a quantitative risk assessment framework is presented. The procedure to execute the framework is elaborated in accordance with the associated mathematical equations. The thermal effect and high pressure leading to potential tank rupture are discussed. The probability of risk for human fatality is calculated. The calculated values using the case study data by following this framework are compared with the risk acceptance criteria. In the final stage of the analysis, the monetary values associated with human fatality are estimated as the result of risk evaluation. Finally, the future research directions are indicated, which include optimizing the risk in hydrogen storage using techniques such as central composite design, response surface method, machine learning and the numerical simulation; and sensitivity analysis of the solution using some available optimization software.

articleTitle: A Damage Accumulation Model Based on Load Interaction Effects
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the fatigue failure of mechanical components of rail vehicles subjected to complex variable amplitude loading loads, a cumulative damage model considering load interaction effects and a life prediction theory are developed in this paper. Firstly, the load loading sequence effect is described and it is proved that the inseparability of fatigue damage and stress level is the main cause of the load sequence effect. Secondly, considering the load interaction effects and the fatigue limit of the structure, a load interaction effects factor is defined and introduced, and a fatigue damage equivalence law is established. Finally, the fatigue damage equivalence rule proposed in this paper is combined with the material toughness dissipation model to construct an improved cumulative damage model under multi-stage variable amplitude loading. Based on steel 45, 16Mn, and Cr41r, which are the materials used in railroad vehicles, by comparing with Miner's rule and the original material toughness dissipation model, it is verified that the improved model proposed in this paper improves the validity and accuracy of fatigue life prediction, which shows that the cumulative damage model proposed in this paper considering the load interaction effects is reasonable and feasible.

articleTitle: Dynamics Modeling of Faulty Gear Systems Considering Time-varying Mesh Stiffness
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: An accurate transmission system dynamics model can effectively provide early warning of faults or failures and can provide theoretical support for gear transmission system fault diagnosis. In this paper, the time-varying mesh stiffness of gears is solved based on the potential energy analysis method, and the root crack fault is introduced to propose the time-varying mesh stiffness of gears with faults and analyze the effects of crack depth and crack inclination on the time-varying mesh stiffness. Considering the time-varying mesh stiffness of the gear with root crack fault, a six-degree-of-freedom gear system dynamics model based on the centralized parameter method with bending-torsion coupling is established. The model is solved numerically and compared with experiments to verify the accuracy of the model. The results show that tooth root cracks affect the stiffness matrix of key parameters of the gear train, which in turn changes the characteristics of the model vibration response.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Planetary Gearbox Based on Transfer Learning and EfficientNet
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In the field of gear fault diagnosis, the traditional convolutional neural networks model has a single precision improvement method and has limitations. This paper proposes a planetary gearbox fault diagnosis model based on Gramian Angular Fields ( GAF ) image coding technology and TL-EfficientNet network model. The collected one-dimensional vibration signal is preprocessed and converted into GAF diagram. The EfficientNet is pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset, the trained feature weights are migrated to the EfficientNet network, and the samples are trained to complete the fault identification of the planetary gearbox. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the fault diagnosis accuracy of planetary gearboxes, reaching 99.49%, and has faster convergence speed and better stability than a single method. At the same time, the TL+EfficientNet-B2 model has strong generalization and can be applied to other fault diagnosis with similar feature distribution data.

articleTitle: Aero Engine Remaining Useful Life Prediction: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aero-engine remaining useful life prediction is critical for improving aircraft reliability and reducing maintenance costs. However, aero-engine RUL prediction faces many challenges, including the effects of multiple operating conditions, insufficient data, and the difficulty of real-time prediction. In this paper, we review RUL prediction methods for aero engines. In addition, we summarize the existing aero-engine-related datasets, common data processing techniques, evaluation criteria, and performance comparisons of some existing methods. Finally, the current challenges and future trends of aero-engine RUL prediction are summarized.

articleTitle: A hybrid method considering a novel health feature and uncertainty quantification for li-ion battery RUL prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of the Lithium-ion battery is extremely crucial for the reliable and safe operation of the battery. Since the complex model or the effective health features (HF) of the traditional prediction methods, a hybrid model-data driven method PL-WOA-ELMAN-PF is proposed to forecast the RUL prediction and uncertainty quantification. Firstly, a novel HF from the voltage curve of the CC charging is extracted, what the Pearson and the first-order partial correlation coefficient verifies the HF is highly pertinent to the battery degradation. Meanwhile, the data-driven method based the new HF and advanced neural network algorithm (WOA-ELMAN) is established while the whale optimization algorithm (WOA) is used to improves the prediction accuracy of the ELMAN. Then, the PL-WOA-ELMAN-PF is proposed based on the particle filter algorithm (PF), while the WOA-ELMAN is introduced to modify the observed value of the dual exponential model. In addition, the PF enables the uncertainty quantification of RUL. Finally, the experimental verification is carried out on two large-cycling and one small-cycling battery degradation datasets. The root mean square error is within 0.01 and the error of RUL estimation is less than 10 cycles, showing that the novel HF is efficient and the proposed method has high accuracy and strong generalization ability.

articleTitle: A Lithium-ion Battery Remaining Useful Life Estimation Method Based on Nonlinear Autoregressive Fusion Model with Exogenous Variables
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) estimation is an important factor in lithium-ion battery system health management (PHM). After the lithium-ion battery reaches the end-of-life (EOL), the capacity drops rapidly, which can lead to battery failure and even safety incidents. Therefore, accurate RUL estimation is a critical and challenging problem. Additionally, this paper proposes a new RUL estimation method: NAR-MOGPR-PF. Firstly, a nonlinear autoregressive neural network (NARNN) is used to establish a time series model of battery capacity degradation as the state equation. Secondly, the three exogenous variables extracted from the battery data are used as observation parameters, and the multi-output Gaussian process regression (MOGPR) is constructed as an observation equation. Finally, a particle filter (PF) algorithm is constructed for capacity correction to realize the fusion between exogenous variables and the NARNN algorithm. The NAR-MOGPR-PF method improves the long-term prediction accuracy of capacity degradation by taking exogenous variables and nonlinear factors into account. Furthermore, the NAR-MOGPR-PF model is compared with autoregressive (AR) methods and the nonlinear autoregressive with exogenous inputs neural network (NARXNN). The proposed RUL estimation approach has higher accuracy and robustness, according to experimental data, and the RUL estimation error is about 1.

articleTitle: Unbalanced Data Classification Model in PHM Field Based on Stacking Integration Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Data-driven artificial intelligence fault detection has always been a hot topic of research. The lack of historical data on faults due to rotating machinery and equipment operating in a healthy state for a long time leads to the problem of data unbalance. This unbalance hinders data-driven fault diagnosis and has become a persistent problem in the field of prognostics and health management (PHM). In this paper, we explored the effectiveness of a mechanical fault diagnosis framework for unbalanced data. This framework combines oversampling algorithms and integrated learning strategies to address the challenge of unbalanced data. We conducted extensive experiments to evaluate the proposed framework using actual unbalanced data. The results showed that the fault diagnosis framework proposed in this paper can significantly improve the prediction accuracy, particularly for a few classes of samples. By applying the GR-SMOTE oversampling algorithm, the proposed model improves the Pre<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">small</inf> index by up to 93.41% and effectively addresses the data unbalance problem.

articleTitle: State-of-health Estimation of Power Battery regarding Capacity and Internal Resistance from Field Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Given the rapid growth of the electric vehicle (EV) industry, the investigation into state-of-health (SOH) estimation of power batteries becomes increasingly important. This study introduces a new approach for estimating power battery capacity and internal resistance using field data. Data preprocessing with EV operational status classification are carried out. Health factors are constructed based on the collected battery charge and discharge data. Power battery capacity is calculated using the ampere-hour integration method during charging, and internal resistance is determined using the Thevenin's equivalent circuit model when discharging. A multi-task convolutional neural network (MT-CNN) model is developed to simultaneously estimate the capacity and the internal resistance of power battery. The results demonstrate that the model employed in this paper exhibits higher SOH estimation accuracy compared to other machine learning methods, including the traditional convolutional neural network (CNN) method.

articleTitle: Improved Knowledge Transfer based on Stacked Denoising Autoencoder and Graph Convolutional Network for Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Intelligent fault diagnosis provides a useful tool for rotating machinery to ensure its safety and condition monitoring, which is a hot topic in prognostics and health management. Although the deep learning algorithms improve the clustering ability for data without labels, its learning efficiency and generalization ability are still limited. To solve this problem, an improved knowledge transfer method is presented based on a stacked denoising autoencoder and graph convolutional network (SDAE-GCN). Stacked structure in SDAE and structure information from GCN improve its learning ability and efficiency. Two open-source bearing datasets are used to evaluate the performance of the proposed SDAE-GCN. The experimental results demonstrate that it has higher accuracy and better generalization for bearing fault diagnosis when the training and test data sets have obvious differences, including different damage sizes/levels, rotation speeds, and working conditions. Noise sensitivity analysis and comparison further show its superiority.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method for the Moving Parts of Equipment Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The healthy and stable operation of the moving parts of mechanical equipment is the guarantee of the overall efficient operation of the equipment. Intelligent diagnosis of moving parts can detect faults in time and reduce the occurrence of malignant accidents. The fault diagnosis method based on deep learning has the requirement of probability distribution for the samples: the training set and the test set should be under the same probability distribution. However, it is difficult to collect fault data in actual equipment operation condition monitoring. Aiming at this problem, this paper studies the fault diagnosis method based on transfer learning. In order to solve the problem that the target domain samples lack labels, this paper designs a migration mechanism based on multi-core maximum mean discrepancy (MK-MMD). The transfer neural network established by combining this mechanism and convolutional neural network (CNN) can extract features that are conducive to fault classification in the target domain. The network relies on unlabeled samples in the target domain and labeled samples in the source domain for training. Finally, the performance of the model was tested on bearing and gear experimental data.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Estimation of Turbofan Engine Based on Selective Ensemble of Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Accurate prediction of residual service life (RUL) is challenging due to large sample sizes and high-dimensional condition monitoring data. To address this, a two-stage selective deep neural network ensemble method was proposed for complex equipment like aviation turbofan engines. It aimed to improve prediction accuracy and convergence efficiency. The method involved generating a diverse candidate set in the first stage, considering multiple methods and eliminating internal coupling relationships using a heterogeneous neural network structure, multi time scale design, and algorithm parameter randomization. In the second stage, a genetic algorithm pruned redundant models, removing poor-performing learners and obtaining optimal candidate subsets. Prediction results were derived by averaging the integrated outputs, providing stable support for maintenance decision-making. Empirical results show that this ensemble method significantly enhances RUL prediction accuracy compared to individual models.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of Frequency Restoration of Wind Power Interconnected Power System Based on Distributed Model Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In view of frequency deviation, the existing frequency recovery control methods mainly have two shortcomings. The first disadvantage is that the control strategy within the wind farm is not designed to avoid the occurrence of secondary frequency dips. Aiming at the unsafe dynamic process frequency deviation, a dynamic process frequency recovery control strategy is proposed. Firstly, the predictive control theory and fuzzy theory of distributed models are introduced. Then, each area of the wind power interconnected power system is modeled to further obtain the model of the entire interconnected power system. Subsequently, the frequency recovery control strategy of the system is designed based on the distributed model predictive control. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed control strategy are verified in the improved IEEE four-machine two-area system and the improved IEEE 10-machine 39-node system.

articleTitle: Prediction of Bearing Remaining Useful Life Based on CNN and Gated Recurrent Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: A rolling bearing remaining life prediction method based on the combination of multi-scale degradation features and CNN-GRU algorithm is proposed in order to accurately describe the degradation trend of rolling bearings in rotating machinery and improve the prediction accuracy of the remaining life of rolling bearings. The method firstly extracts typical time-domain, frequency-domain and time-frequency-domain features from the original vibration signal, normalizes them and constructs a training feature set; secondly, divides the feature set into training set and test set, and inputs them into the CNN-GRU model for training respectively, and the multi-scale feature set is input into the CNN-GRU to fully explore the relationship between the bearing degradation features and the degradation trend to realize the rolling bearing remaining life prediction. The experimental results on XJTU-SY bearing data and IEEE PHM2012 Challenge dataset show that the method can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of the remaining life of bearings and provide a research basis for rolling bearing health management and performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Detecting Incipient Inter-Turn Short Circuit Faults in DFIGs Based on Magnetic Flux Leakage Theory and MPJ-SVDD Analytical Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: This manuscript presents the Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL) theory for incipient inter-turn short circuit (ITSC) faults in the Doubly Fed Induction Generators (DFIGs), which involves the simulation and modeling of the failure mechanism, the quantitative and qualitative description analysis, the health indicator construction, and early weak fault detection and state evaluation based on MFL theory. Firstly, the fault state and the MFL model of the wind generator were constructed from virtual simulation using Matlab/Simulink, due to the fault mechanism of the DFIGs is complex and not straightforward under varying operating conditions and operation loads, therefore the simulations are used in order to obtain datasets and conduct theoretical analysis, including the synthetic failure datasets, feature information representation with feature-based harmonic, feature-based statistical, feature-based entropy, metrics-based distance, feature importance ranking and fusion, development of health indicator and performance analysis based on Multi-Parameter Joint Analysis and Support Vector Data Description (MPJ-SVDD). Finally, the magnetic flux leakage theory for ITSC faults and MPJ-SVDD analytical method is verified by simulation experiments and obtains a better effect of the quantitative and qualitative description.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Rotating Machinery Based on Multi-Sensor Information Decision-Level Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability and safety of rotating machinery systems, a fault diagnosis method based on consistency class weighted soft voting strategy is proposed in this paper, which consists of the basis classifier and decision fusion. The basis classifier includes a multi-scale feature extraction module and a classification module. In the first module, A multi-scale convolution kernel is employed to achieve the extraction and fusion of diverse features. To further improve the generalization performance, feature dimensionality reduction of the global average pooling layer is also introduced to effectively suppress noise interference and reduce overfitting. Then, the multi-scale features are input into the classification module to obtain the prediction label. Finally, a consistent category-weighted soft voting strategy is designed to perform decision fusion, which takes into account the difference in recognition ability of different basis classifiers for the same class while focusing on the difference in recognition ability of the base classifier for each fault class. By combining the probability distribution of prediction labels, the combined weights of different prediction labels are reasonably assigned. The fault dataset of a mechanical fault comprehensive simulation test-bed with Gaussian white noise is used to evaluate the method. The experimental results show that the proposed method is superior to other existing fault diagnosis methods for rotating machinery under noise interference, which proves that it has strong noise suppression ability.

articleTitle: Manufacturing Quality Risk Analysis Approach Considering Production Process Scheme Robustness
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: 5M1E(Man, Machine, Material, Method, Measurement, Environment) are the risk sources of the manufacturing quality, and the production process scheme is the kernel and carrier of the method. However, previous studies of manufacturing quality risk mainly focused on the qualified rate of material and degradation state of machine but ignored the influence of the robustness of the process scheme. Therefore, an extended manufacturing system Reliability-process Quality-product Reliability chain (E-RQR) model was proposed to consider the effect of process robustness on manufacturing quality risk. Firstly, the product process scheme and the connotation of manufacturing quality risk are expounded, and the formation mechanism of manufacturing quality risk based on E-RQR chain is proposed. Secondly, through the collection of manufacturing system operation data and product quality data, the manufacturing quality risk of the manufacturing system and the robustness of process scheme were quantified. On this basis, the technical framework of manufacturing quality risk analysis based on E-RQR chain was proposed. Thirdly, to verify the influence of the robustness of product process scheme on manufacturing quality risk, a robust optimization method of process parameters based on Back Propagation(BP) neural network and Taguchi design was proposed, which proved that robust process scheme can significantly improve manufacturing quality risk. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method was proved by taking a hydraulic pump as the research object.

articleTitle: Analysis of Uneven Wear of Aircraft Landing Gear Hatch Lock Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: An essential part of the aircraft, the aircraft landing gear hatch lock directly affects the landing gear's ability to retract normally. However, there are an increasing number of cases of landing gear system failure brought on by a failure of the lock mechanism's movement accuracy. This is primarily because of uneven wear at the hatch lock mechanism's hinges, which was transferred to the locking hook and resulted in a change in the locking hook's angle. This paper divides the hatch lock mechanism's six hinges around their perimeter to handle the aforementioned issue, and it adopts the dynamics modeling approach of a multi-body mechanism with clearance while taking into account the presence of clearance at the journal and bushing. The law of uneven wear of six bushings under five different initial clearances is studied using the Archard model under the conditions of chosen wear cycles, and the result is the effect of uneven wear on the locking angle of the locking hook, which serves as a guide for the degradation law and life prediction of the hatch lock mechanism.

Author Keywords: Aircraft landing gear hatch lock mechanism

articleTitle: A Three-Interface Data-based Wireless Communication Timeout Fault Diagnosis Method for China Train Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The high-speed train control system is a crucial core equipment ensuring punctual departure and efficient operation of high-speed trains, while wireless timeout faults have always been a challenging issue in its operation and maintenance. Currently, fault diagnosis and maintenance heavily rely on manual planned inspections and post-event handling, leading to low diagnostic efficiency. To address this problem, this paper proposes an intelligent diagnosis method based on three-interface data, utilizing the random forest classification model to improve diagnostic efficiency and reduce the probability of fault occurrences. The paper introduces the communication principles and typical case analysis between the train vehicle speed protection equipment and the ground radio block center in the high-speed train control system. It then elaborates on the fault diagnosis method based on three-interface data, aiming to provide an effective means for dynamic health management of high-speed train control system equipment, ensuring safe and efficient operation of high-speed trains. Through the research presented in this paper, strong support can be provided for handling wireless timeout faults in high-speed train control systems, contributing to the improvement of train operation quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: Equation Chapter 1 Section 1A Method for Component Parameter Importance of Phased Mission Systems Based on Kriging Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Importance measures for parameters of system components can provide useful information for system design and management. For phased mission systems (PMSs), such measures need to consider the dynamic dependence of shared components and the change of reliability logics across phases. This paper presents a Kriging model-based method for estimating the relative importance of component parameters, particularly, mean time between failures (MTBF). Based on simulation results of mission reliability with random sampling of component parameters within their value ranges, Kriging model is built and then its coefficients of deterministic trend terms corresponding to component parameters are used as measures of parameter importance. The proposed approach for importance measure is computational efficient and can reasonably reflect the relative importance of a parameter to mission reliability of PMSs. Numerical results are obtained under different configurations and compared with Sobol's indices for an example phased mission system.

articleTitle: Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis with Time-Frequency Image Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: To accurately describe the trend of rolling bearing fault diagnosis as well as to improve the accuracy and efficiency of fault type discrimination. In this paper, a rolling bearing test dataset under 10 different operating conditions is established, and the AlexNet model multi-feature fusion technique as well as Dropout algorithm and ReLU activation function are used to enhance the performance of the classifier. The test data were obtained from the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) bearing failure dataset. Firstly, the original data set is divided into training and validation sets in the ratio of 3:7; secondly, the training and validation sets are input into the AlexNet model for training to fully exploit the feature data of time-domain images in faulty bearings; finally, the weight file generated from the feature data realizes the classification analysis of rolling bearing fault types. The test results show that the training accuracy reaches 99% and the fault diagnosis type prediction accuracy reaches 98%. It is proved that the method can effectively provide efficient classification efficiency for the time domain signal images of bearing fault diagnosis and provide a research basis for the rolling bearing fault diagnosis classification method.

articleTitle: Reliability Life Evaluation of DC Charger Based on Improved Bootstrap Expansion Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In reliability assessment, a large amount of test data is often needed, because only when the data sample size reaches a certain degree, the corresponding reliability indicators can be calculated according to the traditional statiscs-based calculation method, so as to make the calculation results more real. However, the test data of the newly developed DC charger show the characteristics of small samples. Therefore, this chapter considers the data expansion of the test data samples to meet the requirements of the life prediction method for data capacity. Considering that the Bootstrap method can expand the original small sample size to the large sample size required for reliability analysis, and the operation is simple, this paper based on the Bootstrap small sample expansion method to calculate the life of DC charger and realize the reliability life assessment of DC charger.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of Planetary Gear Based on Fast Harmonic Square Envelope Spectral Kurtosis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of weak fault feature extraction of planetary gear, a method of gear fault feature extraction based on the kurtosis of harmonic square envelope spectrum is proposed in this paper. By optimizing the global kurtosis of the time domain signal to the narrow-band kurtosis near the fault harmonic of the signal frequency domain, the influence of fault components on kurtosis is highlighted, and the interference of other components is weakened, and the kurtosis index of harmonic square envelope spectrum is proposed. Taking the proposed index as the standard to determine the optimal resonance frequency band, the frequency band with the most fault information is selected by using the method of 1/3 binary tree. After the analysis of square envelope spectrum, the gear fault feature is extracted. The experimental results show that the method can reduce the interference of other components and effectively extract the weak fault features of planetary gear.

Author Keywords: Kurtosis index of harmonic square envelope

articleTitle: A Method of Extracting Shaft Speed Based on Ridge Tracking and Phase Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The synchronous acquisition of non-shaft phase reference is a process of synchronous acquisition in the digital domain by using the signal processing method to obtain the shaft speed from the vibration signal without speed. A method of extraction shaft speed based on ridge tracking and phase demodulation is introduced in this paper. The method comprehensively considers the characteristics of time-frequency method and demodulation method, and combines the two methods to extract the shaft speed of the vibration signal. In the process of vibration data processing, firstly, the cost function is used to track the target ridge, then the signal is initially sampled, and then the phase demodulation is used to get the instantaneous velocity from the resampled vibration data. An example is given to verify the effectiveness of the ridge tracking demodulation method and the accuracy of shaft speed extraction.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Assistant Diagnosis System for Wind Turbine Units
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Intelligent diagnosis is a key task in the construction of “smart wind farm”. Therefore, this paper proposes a new idea of intelligent diagnosis based on knowledge graph and develops a set of intelligent assistant diagnosis system for wind power units. This intelligent assistant diagnosis system is based on expert knowledge, combined with artificial intelligence, big data analysis and other technologies to form a set of operation and maintenance assistant system that integrates intelligence and knowledge. This paper introduces the construction process of knowledge graph and the intelligent diagnosis reasoning framework in detail, and develops an intelligent assistant diagnosis system for wind turbines units based on Java EE platform. Finally, a wind turbine unit is used as the research object to verify the effectiveness of the intelligent diagnosis reasoning model based on the knowledge graph and the advantage of intelligent assistant diagnosis system for wind turbine units.

articleTitle: Lifetime Prediction Based on Age-State Dependent Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As a key component of prediction and health management, remaining useful life prediction is critical to improving system reliability, availability and safety. Accurate life prediction is based on a reliable prediction model. Most of the existing studies are based on age-dependent models. However, the degradation process of a system is not only influenced by age but also by the system state in real situations. To address this problem, an age-state dependent diffusion model is proposed in this paper. The maximum likelihood estimation algorithm is used to perform parameter estimation. The validity of the proposed model is verified by simulation data set.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Digital Twin Model for Gear Box Operation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to perceive the operating status of the gearbox in all aspects and find faults in a timely and effective manner, an intelligent operation and maintenance management method for gearbox based on digital twin technology is proposed. By establishing a digital twin model of the gearbox, integrating online physical signals, simulation data, motion models, and offline test data, Build a gearbox health management and predictive maintenance process to realize the perception and prediction. A digital twin prototype system was developed for partial functional verification, which provides a case for the application of digital twin technology.

articleTitle: A New Binary Classification Twin Uncertain Support Vector Machine with Imprecise Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In the recent years, more and more people choose high-speed railway as the transportation to travel. Therefore, ensure the safety of passengers is of great importance. The braking system is a vital system to ensure the safety of railway, therefore, there are many methods focusing on the fault diagnostics of the braking system. Because of the errors of sensors, the data observed from the braking system are not precise. Besides, due to the continuous operation of the railway, the parameters are changing all the time, therefore, it is difficult to obtain the precise data.
