Based on the above reasons, the method to deal with imprecise data is important for us to find the faults of the braking system. Twin support vector machine (TWSVM) is a commonly used model to classify the normal data and fault data in the field of fault diagnostics, which is the extended model of the support vector machine (SVM). However, the traditional TWSVM method cannot deal with the imprecise data. Considering the imprecise data as the uncertain variable in Uncertainty theory, twin uncertain support vector machine (TWUSVM) is proposed in this paper to classify the imprecise data. It is proved by a real dataset of high-speed railway braking system and two puiblic datasets that the proposed model has good performance in classifying the imprecise data. Therefore, the proposed method can be widely applied in the field of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Incipient Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing Based on ACMD and Parametric Optimized MNAD
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: For the detection of incipient bearing faults, formulating decoupling noise reduction of vibration signal and fault enhancement strategy is the key to overcoming noise interference and recovering periodic pulses from the original signal. This paper's method of achieving the above diagnosis is based on adaptive chirp mode decomposition (ACMD) and parametric optimized minimum noise amplitude deconvolution (POMNAD). Firstly, ACMD is used to reduce the influence of noise components. Secondly, MNAD, which has an outstanding ability to recover periodic pulses from the original signal, is performed on the noise-reduced component. However, practical applications have consistently shown that the fault characteristic frequency (FCF) parameter of MNAD must be selected adaptively to ensure MNAD works at its best. To solve the parameter setting problem, POMNAD is proposed in this paper. Taking the Gini index of the squared envelope spectrum (GISES) as the fitness function, and iteratively searching through the gray wolf optimization (GWO) algorithm, POMNAD can adaptively obtain the optimal FCF parameter of the filter. After ACMD and POMNAD, the envelope analysis is performed to determine the fault condition. Simulation and experiment indicate that the proposed method correctly detects the incipient fault of rolling bearings.

articleTitle: Research on Expansion Neighborhood and Cost Function-Based A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The ENCF-A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> (Expansion Neighborhood and Cost Function-Based A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup>) algorithm tackles challenges in the traditional A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> method such as lengthy paths and numerous turns. It achieves this by expanding the search scope, elongating step distances, and minimizing path deflection angles. The algorithm's efficiency is enhanced through the incorporation of obstacle distribution and a cost function that encourages movement toward the target. Additionally, the introduction of a turn cost function and the removal of redundant nodes prevent unnecessary detours, resulting in more realistic motion paths. Experimental outcomes exhibit significant improvements: ENCF-A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> reduces path nodes by 82.61%, decreases deflection angles by 71.96%, and shortens path distances by 9.71%. Consequently, this algorithm notably enhances the efficiency of tracing Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) in intricate environments.

articleTitle: Correlation energy singular spectrum decomposition: a new intelligent damage recognition method for crane girder structure of engineering machinery
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: To achieve a more refined and adaptive structural damage recognition of the engineering machinery (crane girder), a new time-frequency analysis method based on Correlation Energy Singular spectrum decomposition (named CESSD) is proposed for the first time in this paper. It is employed for the main girder structural vibration response analysis and structural damage recognition of engineering mechanical (crane). The proposed CESSD algorithm constructs a trajectory matrix and adaptively selects the embedding dimension length. The original Singular Spectrum Decomposition (Singular Spectrum decomposition, SSD) can be determined to obtain the number of modal components. Secondly, its main sensitive component can be determined through the correlation energy ratio of the signal. The frequency and amplitude of the corresponding main sensitive component are obtained. Afterward, the modal parameters of the main girder structure of the crane based on the CESSD algorithm are identified using the CESSD algorithm. Finally, the damage index is defined according to the component signals’ instantaneous frequency and instantaneous energy, and the structural damage is identified. Accordingly, the simulation experiment of the main girder of the crane demonstrates that compared with other structural damage methods, such as EMD and SSD, the proposed method can more accurately realize the adaptive detection and recognition of the crane damage.

articleTitle: Intermittent Fault Diagnosis Method Based On Graph Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Intermittent faults are widespread in various systems, which often greatly reduce the mean time to failure of the system, lead to the replacement of normal components, and increase unnecessary maintenance and support costs. The research of intermittent fault diagnosis methods is of great significance for improving equipment reliability, reducing system maintenance and support costs, and improving the level of intelligent manufacturing. At present, various machine learning methods have received more and more attention in the field of fault diagnosis, but the research on intermittent fault diagnosis based on graph convolutional neural network is less carried out. Compared with convolutional neural networks, graph convolutional neural networks are good at processing graph data which is more widely existing. Based on this, this paper decides to construct an intermittent fault diagnosis model based on graph convolutional neural network for intermittent fault localization. This paper proposes a method to convert the intermittent fault voltage waveform data into graph data. The original waveform is decomposed into six sub-waveforms by wavelet decomposition, and the edge connection is defined by the Pearson correlation coefficient between the sub-waveforms. On this basis, six different graph convolutional network models are built, the network is trained and optimized, and the accuracy of 90.38% is obtained on the test set.

articleTitle: Vibration Analysis of Split-Torque Transmission System with Tooth Crack Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: This paper focuses on the vibration analysis for tooth crack detection of split-torque transmission system. Firstly, on the basis of the potential energy principle, a healthy tooth model and a cracked tooth model are established respectively. Corresponding mathematical equations of gear mesh stiffness are derived. Then, the dynamic model of a split-torque transmission system is established considering the translational and torsional motions. By implanting the tooth crack into different gears, the vibration responses of the split-torque transmission system are simulated and analyzed, and vibration signals of various conditions can be obtained to provide basis for the development of feature extraction and fault diagnosis methods.

articleTitle: Rotor Dynamic Analysis of Supercritical Carbon Dioxide Bryton Cycle Coaxial Integrated Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The rotor system plays a very important role in supercritical carbon dioxide Brayton cycle system, and its dynamic problem will directly affect the motion stability and safety of the whole unit. In this paper, the rotor dynamic model of supercritical CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> coaxial unit is established by finite element method, and the critical speed, modal shape and unbalance response of the rotor are studied. The first seven critical speed of the rotor and the first seven natural frequency of the rotor at the working speed are calculated. The bending modal of the rotor and the position where the rotor amplitude is the largest are analyzed, which can provide reference for the optimization design of the rotor stability. The influences of mass unbalances at the operational speed of rotor are analyzed. The research can provide some suggestions for the optimal design and actual operation of the supercritical CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> coaxial integrated unit.

articleTitle: A Fully Transparent Deep Signal Operator Network for Intelligent Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis (IFD) based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) has made significant breakthroughs in recent years. However, the black-box nature of AI-enabled IFD hinders its interpretability, which poses a risk to safe-critical industrial assets. In this paper, we propose a fully transparent deep network for IFD using a basic neural node with a signal operator. The signal operator layer uses probability metrics to determine the connection of these signal operators. The signal operators used in the layer include Hilbert transform and interpretable neural Fourier operators. Additionally, to strengthen the sparsity of the metrics, we use L1 norm to learn a more compact structure. Through a case study of self-powered condition monitoring for bearings, we verify the effectiveness of the training and transparency of the proposed method. Moreover, transparent IFD is of utmost importance in industrial applications and the proposed deep signal operator network opens up a new and promising research sub-field of transparent IFD.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Evaluation Method When Data Follow Weibull Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The lock mechanism of the aircraft cabin door is one of the key components, which is directly related to the normal opening and closing of the aircraft cabin door, the lock mechanism because of its high reliability, high cost, experimental data often have a small sample, so its reliability evaluation method is worth discussing. Based on the analysis of the influencing factors of the life of the locking mechanism, the locking angle and the lock lock displacement offset are selected as the performance degradation characteristic quantities, and based on the fact that the failure threshold corresponding to the two failure characteristic quantities has been determined, the consistency of the evolution trend of the degradation data of the two is evaluated by combining the physical test and the simulation test, and the degradation model is established by the Weibull distribution to evaluate the reliability of the Weibull distribution of the random variable of the complex mechanism.

articleTitle: Reliability Assignment Method for Flight Control Computer Based on Fault Tree and Cost Function
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the reliability allocation problem in the design of redundancy flight control computer system of a certain type of teletype aircraft, a reliability allocation method combining fault tree and cost function is proposed. Firstly, the logical relationship between system functional failure and underlying equipment failure is analyzed by using the fault tree, and the functional relationship between the top event and the probability of occurrence of the bottom events is established; then, the concept of cost function is introduced, and the quantitative relationship between the generalized cost and the reliability of underlying equipment is established by combining the complexity of the equipment, the technical difficulty, the working time, and the working environment; next, the probability of occurrence of the top event and the generalized cost are considered to construct the optimization strategy for the reliability allocation scheme in optimization space; finally, according to the optimization strategy, the allocation scheme is solved iteratively in the optimization space. The results show that the allocation method can minimize the corresponding cost introduced by the system reliability enhancement by fully considering various factors on the basis of meeting the system reliability requirements.

articleTitle: A New Method of Testability Quantitative Requirements Demonstration Based on Efficacy Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Testability is an important factor affecting the efficacy of aerospace products, and the testability requirements of products are directly related to the quality of testability design. At present, the main method of testability requirements demonstration in China is comparative demonstration method, which is difficult to consider the differences of specific products and does not consider the efficacy requirements of products. In this paper, a new testability quantitative requirements demonstration method based on efficacy simulation is proposed, the efficacy transformation model is constructed, the simulation method based on testability comprehensive is proposed, the testability requirements demonstration software based on efficacy simulation is developed, and the case is verified. Case verification results show that this method can realize the efficacy simulation and testability quantitative requirements demonstration of products.

articleTitle: Reliability Estimation and Impact Analysis of High-Voltage Distribution Box Under Series Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: During electrical design, research and development, product used to be overdesigned due to excessive safety margins often occurs due to unpredictable product reliability. In order to achieve product optimization design, electronic products need effective reliability estimation models and impact analysis methods. This study takes the high-voltage distribution box of new energy vehicles as the research object, and proposes it according to the national standard GB/T37963-2019 and the sensitivity principle Calculation model and analysis method of system failure rate and component influence under the assumption of series model. Evaluate the average life of the high-voltage distribution box, identify key components, provide a reference for engineers and technicians to estimate reliability, and lay the foundation for reliability design screening and reliability growth strategy decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Characteristics of Gear System with Crack Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In this paper, the potential energy method is used to establish the calculation model of the spur gear meshing stiffness with tooth root crack fault. By the established model, this paper calculates and plots the spur gear meshing stiffness curve in four states: normal, 1mm crack, 1.5mm crack and 2mm crack. Analyzing the meshing stiffness curve, the influence of different crack depths on the gear meshing stiffness can be obtained. Moreover, a dynamic model of spur gear system is established to obtain the dynamic responses. The results show that there are obvious periodic impulses in the time domain, and the side frequency bands appear near the fundamental frequency in the frequency domain. And with the expansion of crack depth, the amplitudes continue to increase. The research results have certain value for the fault diagnosis of crack fault.

articleTitle: Intelligent Crack Damage Identification for Compressor Blade Based on Transfer Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Advanced sensing techniques and intelligent algorithms have greatly contributed to the development of structural health monitoring & damage identifications. As the most common-used electrical equipment in modern industry, compressors play an irreplaceable role in petrochemical and other process industries, usually accompanied by complex operation conditions such as variable speed. Its weak and vulnerable components, blades, will inevitably suffer varying degrees of damage in service. This study introduces the graph structure-based decision-making into the compressor's blade crack damage identification under variable operating conditions and thereby proposes the transfer graph neural network enhanced damage identification (TGNNeDI) method. Firstly, damage signal-based affinity graphs are constructed to express the latent damage information beyond Euclidean space. Then the developed multi-order graph convolutional network and domain discriminator layers are used to extract the domain-invariant damage features, which will be fed into the linear layer for class prediction. Finally, real-measured experiments under the compressor experimental platform are utilized to cross-verify the established TGNNeDI method under variable rotating speed conditions.

articleTitle: Civil Aircraft Reliability Top-Level Requirements Capture and Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Civil aircraft development process is requirements-driven, with requirements capture and decomposition as the core. Civil aircraft top-level requirements are a key part of the aircraft development process. Reliability top-level requirements are traced up to stakeholder requirements and decomposed down to the design specifications of the equipment. From theoretical and practical experiences, this paper outlines the idea and scope of the aircraft top-level requirements capture work, and the requirement capture and decomposition of top-level reliability key indicators to ensure the completeness, comprehensiveness, correctness and completeness of the final obtained aircraft reliability top-level requirements.

articleTitle: The Effects of Binaural Auditory Modality on Operators in A Flight Simulation Task
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The thesis describes a within-group study on the effect of dichotic listening on participants' reaction time, situation awareness and workload. 21 participants are subjected to two flight simulation trials, in which they are engaged in the primary tasks regarding basic flight operations, meanwhile, they are required to change the altitude and heading by instructions from the Air Traffic Controllers (ATCs), they also have to respond to TCAS warning which may activate at any time. Other distractions in the scenarios includes the checklist procedures conducted by the other ‘pilot’ and the simulated cockpit background noise. During the trials, two auditory cues conditions are compared (monaural and binaural). Their performance are recorded in the form of videos for the following analysis. After each trial, each participant is required to complete the SART and NASA-TLX self-rating techniques by the perception based on the experience. The results (n=21) indicate the statistically significant differences between the two auditory modalities in reaction time, situation awareness and workload.

articleTitle: A Multi-Level FW-UAV Fault Diagnosis Solution Based on Multi-Task Learning Under Small Samples
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Deep learning provides more advanced solutions for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) fault diagnosis, but most existing deep learning methods are designed for a single fault diagnosis task. A UAV is a complex system with multiple coupled components, requiring the simultaneous execution of several different Faulty Component Diagnosis (FCD) level 1 tasks and Fault Level Detection (FLD) level 2 tasks. In addition, scarcity of fault samples is a recognized problem. Therefore, we propose a Multi-Level Fault Diagnosis (MLFD) method for Fixed-Wing UAV (FW-UAV) based on multi-task learning. MLFD jointly trains the FCD and FLD tasks by Cross-stitch units under small samples, adaptively sharing the public information of the two tasks, enriching the fault diagnosis knowledge, and at the same time improving the model's ability to handle the two tasks. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed method in real FW-UAV failure data.

articleTitle: A Reliability Modeling Method for Directed Acyclic Graph Network System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: A mission reliability modeling method is proposed for directed acyclic graph network systems. By decomposing it into sub directed acyclic graphs along the path direction until it is decomposed into device units, and paralleling the sub directed acyclic graphs adjacent to each node, a mission reliability block diagram model of the network system is constructed in which the sub networks and devices are layer by layer parallel, and the discrete event simulation method is used for calculation, which can effectively solve the mission reliability modeling and calculation problem of such network system in engineering.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Multistage Gearbox Based on Adaboost Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In this paper, by building a multi-stage gearbox fault simulation test bench, the operation status of the gearbox in six different fault states is simulated and the gear vibration signals are collected. The signal is decomposed into different IMF components from high to low by Ceemdan and fault sensitive features are extracted. By constructing the SVM-Adaboost ensemble learning model, the Ceemdan time-frequency energy feature is used as the model input for fault diagnosis of multi-stage gearboxes.

articleTitle: Reliability Qualification Test Method for Airborne Products with Integrated Software and Hardware
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: With the development of information technology, integrated hardware and software products are increasingly used in key areas such as aerospace, weapons and equipment, transportation, and communication networks. The interface between product hardware and software has become more and more blurred, and it has been difficult to simply divide the product into hardware part and software part. This paper establishes the construction method of the reliability test profile of the integrated hardware and software products to provide the basis for the reliability test design of the airborne products with integrated hardware and software.

articleTitle: Intelligent Diagnosis of Planetary Gearboxes Based on DAE-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Planetary gearboxes (PGs) are the core transmission components of complex rotating machinery. The diverse forms of internal gear faults often complicate diagnosis and maintenance work. To improve the fault diagnosis accuracy of PGs, this paper proposes a method for diagnosing PG faults based on deep autoencoders (DAE) and convolutional neural networks (CNN). The method fully utilizes the deep learning capability of DAE and combines it with the precise recognition ability of CNN for fault features. Through precise learning in the encoding layer, it achieves deep dimensionality reduction of fault features and further learns these features after dimensionality reduction by CNN. Compared to traditional CNN, the method reduces the computation parameters and resource consumption, resulting in higher precision intelligent fault diagnosis. Experimental results demonstrate that DAE-CNN exhibits stronger fault diagnosis ability than traditional networks.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Gearbox Using Discrete Wavelet Transform and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In the realm of gearbox research, predicting the remaining service life of gear shafts is a crucial task. This paper investigates the essential techniques for gear shaft life prediction. Firstly, the time synchronous averaging algorithm and discrete wavelet transform are implemented to preprocess and extract features from the vibration signals of the gear shafts. Secondly, to more accurately reflect the changing patterns of remaining service life of gear shafts, the vector autoregression (VAR) model, which considers the mutual effects of different independent variables, is employed to obtain the residual of the entire dataset. Finally, the Back-Propagation (BP) neural network was employed to forecast the remaining operative lifespan of the gear shaft, precluding possible safety hazards and financial losses. The relative error between the predictive output and actual values of the model was within 6. The research results indicate that this technique enables precise prognostication of the service life of gear shafts, offering sound support for the maintenance and preservation of mechanical equipment.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven CEEMDAN-DRSCN-Based RUL Prediction Method for UAV Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Electric UAV propulsion systems have an advantage over fuel-powered UAVs. As the “heart” of an electric UAV, the remaining service life prediction of its electrical system is an important estimation parameter in battery health management. In this paper, we propose a data-driven incremental prediction method that integrates empirical modal decomposition and incremental learning models. First, a stochastic configuration network (SCN)-based incremental prediction model is designed to update the model input parameters by adding new data to overcome the in-flight data variation and employing Decay Regularization (DR) to avoid the output weight overfitting problem. Then, Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) is introduced to perform nonlinear mode decomposition on the UAV battery service data. Finally, experiments are conducted on the NASA UAV battery dataset. The experimental results show that the proposed CEEMDAN-DRSCN has good prediction performance and stability, prediction error is as low as 0.0004.

articleTitle: Research of Definition and Analysis Method for Civil Aircraft Turnaround Time
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aircraft turnaround time is one of the most important competitive indicators of aircraft, which has an important impact on the operational success and passenger satisfaction of airlines. Therefore, in the aircraft concept demonstration phase and preliminary design phase, it is particularly important to define the turnaround time based on market operation, and confirm whether the ability of aircraft can meet the requirements of the indicators through calculation and analysis. This paper proposes the definition of turnaround time of single-aisle aircraft and dual-aisle aircraft from the perspective of competition and market operation. In this paper, all the turnaround tasks in the full-service turnaround scenarios are analyzed in detail, and the analysis method and the turnaround task timing table are given. Finally, an application example is given based on a certain type of dual-aisle civil aircraft.

articleTitle: Research of model-based reliability requirement transformation technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to solve the difficulties faced in the reliability requirement analysis for complex engineering systems, the method of model-based reliability requirement transformation were studied. By combining the task scenes with the system reliability requirement analysis process, the transformation of system reliability requirements can be achieved. This paper introduces the idea of model-based system engineering(MBSE), and describes the method of reliability requirement transformation. Through this method, the reliability requirement can be transferred to operational, maintenance, manufacturing, test, and other requirements.

articleTitle: A MP-based Method for Periodic Fault Impulses Detection in Rotating Machinery
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As the core component of contemporary industry, rotating machinery has been applied in various industries. However, rotating machinery typically serves in harsh environments, which makes it very prone to performance degradation or even failure. And failure or decline in performance will cause significant economic losses and even casualties. Thus, the investigation of rotating machinery condition monitoring is critical to guarantee the safe running of machinery and the reduction of maintenance costs. However, condition monitoring focus on traditional signal processing technologies relies too heavily on expert experience and imbalanced data limits the application of intelligent diagnostic methods in practice. In view of the limitation, a novel approach based on matrix profile (MP) is presented for periodic impulses detection in rotating machinery condition monitoring. In this work, the local matrix profile (LMP) is first used to detect periodic impulses which are caused by the local damage of rotating machinery. Then, in order to improve the impulsive feature, an adaptive strategy for parameter selection based on L-kurtosis index is introduced. Furthermore, to examine the performance of the presented method, the simulated signal and actual data are analyzed. The findings indicate that the approach can successfully determine the state of rotating machinery.

articleTitle: Weighted Squared Envelope Dispersion Entropy as a Nonlinear Measure for Dynamic Health Monitoring of Rotating Machineries
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Being a new non-linear measure, dispersion entropy (DisE) is a promising parameter for dynamic health monitoring of rotating machineries. However, under heavy noisy scenario, transient impulses corresponding to a rotating machinery fault gets submerged under the noise components present in the collected vibration signal. As a result, DisE not only fails to detect the presence of a fault at the earliest stage of inception but also performs poorly in monitoring the growth of the fault. Aiming at overcoming the limitations of DisE in dynamic health monitoring of rotating machineries, in this paper, impulses corresponding to a fault is extracted by suppressing the unnecessary noise component by weighting the squared envelope of the collected vibration signal. Due to the application of weighted squared envelope in calculating the DispE, the proposed measure is termed as weighted squared envelope dispersion entropy (WSEDisE). Effectiveness of WSEDisE in dynamic health monitoring of rotating machineries is verified by an experimental run to failure bearing vibration data. Experimental results show that WSEDisE not only overcomes the weaknesses of original DisE but also demonstrates better performance than conventional entropy-based methods such as permutation entropy (PE) and advanced DisE based method namely multiscale DisE (MDisE).

articleTitle: Rail Corrugation Diagnosis Based on Time-frequency Demodulation Methods and Dynamic Responses
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Rail corrugation, as one of the main types of rail damage, can directly affect the safety and stability of rail vehicles. In this paper, the vehicle-track coupling dynamic model and the mathematical model of rail corrugation are established to obtain the dynamic response of rail vehicle under the excitation of rail corrugation. Then, three advanced time-frequency demodulation methods for feature extraction of rail corrugation are introduced and their characteristics are discussed. Finally, the feature extraction performance of three time-frequency demodulation methods is quantitatively compared and evaluated by using the wheel-track dynamic simulation signal containing rail corrugation under variable speed condition, and the validity of applying time-frequency demodulation method to the time-frequency feature extraction of rail corrugation is verified.

articleTitle: Application of Impulse Demodulation Analysis in the Abnormal Noise Fault Diagnosis of Robot Joint
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In view of the obvious abnormal noise in the joint of an industrial robot at low speed, the joint vibration signal is collected and analyzed by impulse demodulation method. Firstly, in order to improve signal-to-noise ratio effectively, the fault signal is detected and demodulated by vibration waveform envelope method. Then, the filtered signal is processed by FFT algorithm to extract the characteristic frequency caused by low frequency impulse. Finally, it is found that there are abnormal periodic shocks in the vibration signal at low speed. The shock modulation frequency is the motor rotation frequency. At high speed, abnormal noise and abnormal shocks disappear. It is inferred that the abnormal sound is caused by the poor meshing of the joint gear caused by the abnormal external load. The monitoring results show that the gear and bearing of the joint reducer are in normal condition, so there is no need to check the robot disassembly, and a large overhaul work is avoided.

articleTitle: Longitudinal Degradation Data Simulation Method Based on Sequential Statistics
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to trace the degradation process of individual railroad wagon wheels for effective preventive differential maintenance, a longitudinal data generation method is proposed applying to wheel tread wear data that are highly aggregated and ungrouped. A generalized linear model with a Gamma linkage function is used to model the overall degradation of the wheel tread wear process, and the variation space of individual wheel tread wear increments at adjacent inspection mileage is constructed by sequential statistics to trace the wheel wear trajectory. Comparison with experimental wheel tread wear data shows that the proposed method can effectively generate longitudinal data, which could provide ideas for individual wheel degradation modeling and differential maintenance.

articleTitle: A Novel Deep Multi-Source Domain Adaptation Framework for Remaining Useful Life Prediction Across Operating Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a rapid development of data-driven domain adaptive remaining useful life prediction methods. It can more effectively predict training (source) and testing (target) condition monitoring data with different distributions. In practice, the target domain is not correlated with only one source domain, and label data can be obtained from multiple diverse domains, which leads to incomplete information from the Sigle-source Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (SUDA) method, thus limiting the prediction accuracy. This paper is the first to propose a multi-source Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (MUDA) method for remaining useful life prediction. A challenging practical situation was investigated where the source domain data came from multiple datasets with different operating conditions. A prediction framework MFDAN (Multiple Feature Domain Align Network) is proposed, consisting of a feature extraction phase and a regression prediction phase. Extensive validations using an aero-engine dataset, with different domain adaptation methods and metrics, show that the proposed multi-source prediction method offers a new and promising approach.

articleTitle: Multicomponent Nonstationary Fault Feature Extraction Based On Match Chirplet Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Mechanical fault signals are usually multicomponent and non-stationary, which makes the accurate extraction of multicomponent fault features a challenging task. Therefore, this paper proposes an Match Chirplet transform that can adaptively match the time-varying laws of the components to handle multicomponent nonstationary signals. It estimates the Chirp rate parameter in advance from a rough time-frequency result. Then the basis which match the signal is constructed for secondary time-frequency transformation to obtain the optimal time-frequency representation. Finally, post-processing is performed along frequency direction to extract the point with the maximum local energy. Excellent energy concentration and noise robustness were verified through a multicomponent simulated signal. Furthermore, the performance of the proposed algorithm was tested in the actual signal section by applying it to a bat echo signal and bearing fault signals.

articleTitle: Research on Circuit Performance Degradation Prediction Method Based on SSA-LSTM & GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: During the actual operational phase, electronic systems typically go through a series of intermediate degradation states from their initial normal state until a fault occurs. By utilizing degradation data to predict changes in the operational state, it becomes possible to take proactive measures before the electronic system's performance reaches the failure threshold, thereby preventing unexpected situations. A novel performance degradation prediction method called SSA-LSTM & GRU is introduced to overcome the shortcomings of accuracy and efficiency in single model performance degradation prediction. The method starts by applying singular spectrum analysis (SSA) reconstruction and decomposition to the data to extract the relevant components. Subsequently, an adaptive weighting module is incorporated, combining the long and short term memory (LSTM) network with the gated recurrent unit (GRU) network, resulting in the SSA-LSTM & GRU performance degradation prediction method. Experimental results validate the effectiveness and feasibility of this approach, demonstrating its superior prediction accuracy compared to single model methods.

Author Keywords: long and short term memory network

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Coal Machine Equipment Based on Differential Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: A differential oscillator detector was constructed to extract fault features of coal machinery equipment, which is constrained by factors such as variable operating conditions and loads. In order to detect multi-fault characteristic frequency by using differential oscillator detector, the frequency spectrum of differential oscillator phase diagram is analyzed, and a method of extracting multi-frequency characteristics is proposed, which breaks through the limitation that differential oscillator can only detect a single frequency. The fault example of driving motor of belt conveyor in coal mine is used to verify it. The results show that the multi-feature extraction method based on differential oscillator can effectively extract the early fault features of coal mining equipment with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Remaining useful lifetime prediction based on the fusion of Attention-LSTM and Wiener process
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of remaining useful lifetime (RUL) prediction, an RUL prediction method based on the fusion of the attention-long short-term memory (Attention-LSTM) network and the Wiener process is proposed. Firstly, the degradation trend of the Wiener process is extracted by empirical mode decomposition (EMD). Then, the degradation trend is predicted by using LSTM with the attention mechanism. Finally, the analytical expression of the RUL is derived based on the first hitting time (FHT) principle. The superior performance of the proposed method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Compound Fault Diagnosis of Gearbox Via Simplifying Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Accurate detection of compound fault in gearbox is significance to ensure the reliable and safe operation of rotating machinery. Due to various unknown single or compound faults, existing methods are difficult to achieve high-precision fault diagnosis for gearbox. This paper proposes a compound fault diagnosis method based on simplifying Graph Convolutional Network (SGCN), which can detect single and compound faults in gearboxes under different operating conditions. Firstly, the frequency data of vibration signals is used to construct the undirected complete graph structure. Then, we propose the SGCN model to detect the compound faults of gears and bearings in gearbox. The Southeast University (SEU) gearbox dataset and wind turbine driven system fault simulation test bench dataset are used to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Compared with other two methods, the proposed method show good performance in diagnosis accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: An Effective Task allocation Algorithm for Unmanned Surface Vehicle System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Task allocation plays a crucial role in enabling unmanned surface vehicles (USV) to operate autonomously and intelligently. However, in recent years, with the increasing scale of USVs and the growing complexity of task environments, existing algorithms have gradually become inadequate for current application scenarios, exhibiting deficiencies in both real-time performance and effectiveness. Traditional heuristic algorithms are often prone to local convergence and yield suboptimal solutions. Optimization methods are better suited for environments with simple constraints and small task scales, but their real-time performance deteriorates rapidly as task scales increase. To address these issues, this paper proposes an improved genetic algorithm based on the K-means clustering algorithm (K-means Based Genetic Algorithm, KBGA). First, we need to establish an USVs task allocation model that meets the requirements of the marine environment. Subsequently, we employ the K-means clustering algorithm to preprocess the environmental information, enhancing the effectiveness of initial task allocation in USV systems. Lastly, we enhance the optimization capabilities of the genetic algorithm by improving the genetic computational steps, thereby improving the effectiveness and stability of final task allocation in USVs systems. We comprehensively evaluate the improved genetic algorithm based on the K-means clustering algorithm under capability-limited environments and multi-task scenarios. Through comparative analysis using simulations, our algorithm demonstrates higher effectiveness and stability compared to relevant algorithms.

articleTitle: A Review of MEMS Reliability Development
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: With the wide application of MEMS in aerospace and other industries as well as the continuous improvement of its importance, more and more attentions have been paid to MEMS reliability. This paper expounded the understanding of MEMS reliability, and then summarized the present research status of MEMS common failure modes and mechanisms, MEMS reliability design and analysis technology, MEMS reliability testing technology and MEMS reliability evaluation technology. Finally, the development trends of MEMS reliability technology were discussed.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection of Freight Car Bolt Fault Based on Improved YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Abstra ct-Trouble of Moving freight car Detection System (TFDS) is an important part of railway traffic security safeguard equipment monitoring and management system. The key parts of freight car are mainly discriminated by manual from collected images. At present, the manual inspection of TFDS system has a large workload and a short inspection time, and the quality of the list inspection is easily affected by the list inspection personnel. Aiming at the shortcomings of the current TFDS system in practical application, by introducing deep learning, an intelligent recognition algorithm for freight car bolts based on deep learning is studied, so as to realize the recognition of railway freight car bolts. The results show that the recognition rate of the proposed algorithm for bolts reaches more than 96%. The automatic recognition algorithm can reduce the influence of human subjectivity on the overhaul operation, improve the quality and efficiency of the overhaul operation, and improve the safety guarantee ability of the TFDS system.

articleTitle: Fault Modeling of Harmonic Reducers Based on Current Signal Under Time Varying Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The harmonic reducer is often used in the industrial robot due to the characteristics of large deceleration ratio and high transmission efficiency. Flexible thin-wall bearing is one of the core structures of the harmonic reducer, and compared with ordinary bearings, its inner and outer rings have unique thin-wall structure, which deforms periodically under the extrusion of the elliptical camshaft and the alternating load. The above characteristic and working conditions make it the most vulnerable part of the reducer. What's more, the harmonic reducer is subjected to the influence caused by the changing speed and load under practical operating conditions of industrial robots, which can increase the possibility to damage. Therefore, we propose a fault model of harmonic reducer for industrial robots based on current signal under varying load and speed. The proposed model considers the vibration of flexible bearing caused by the long and short axes changing alternately. In addition, the working condition of varying load and speed is also considered in the fault frequency model. The experiment of harmonic reducer is conducted in case of three common parts damage on the flexible bearing, and the effectiveness of the proposed model is also verified. Results show that this model can clearly reflect the actual fault situation of the harmonic reducer used in industrial robots.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Quantification Based Detection and Diagnosis for Unexpected Accident in Nuclear Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: A nuclear accident can have severe consequences for human society. Recently, deep learning detection and diagnosis technology has been widely employed in the nuclear field, thanks to advancements in artificial intelligence technology. However, training a deep learning (DL) model requires a significant number of labeled samples, and it is not possible to assess unexpected accidents. To address this issue, this study proposes an intelligent accident detection approach based on uncertainty. Initially, a probabilistic deep learning network is utilized to obtain diagnostic findings. Next, both known and unexpected accident samples are used to provide quantitative measures of uncertainty. The unexpected accident samples are then identified, and a threshold is established using the statistical outlier detection method to compute the overall detection rate. The operator is provided with the results for human intervention. Furthermore, the advanced nuclear system's integrated simulation experiment platform offers the opportunity to study with sample data from simulated accidents. The results of these experiments provide support for the effectiveness of the suggested probabilistic-based intelligent detection strategy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Centrifugal Pumps via Self-Attention and Convolutional Fusion Method Based on Acoustic-Vibration Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The current fault diagnosis methods for centrifugal pumps mainly rely on the analysis and research of vibration signals. However, there are certain difficulties in collecting vibration signals under certain operating conditions, and a single signal performs poorly in the presence of noise labels, while sound signals also have rich characteristic information that can be utilized. This article focuses on the performance of fault diagnosis for centrifugal pumps under acoustic and vibration signals. Firstly, short-time Fourier transform is used to obtain time-frequency domain features from one-dimensional vibration signals and acoustic signals. Then, the two signals are fused and recombined as input signals, and self-attention and convolutional fusion methods are added for fault diagnosis classification. On the centrifugal pump dataset, the proposed method has significantly improved accuracy compared to traditional convolutional neural networks under different noise label ratios.

articleTitle: Thermal simulation optimization of DC charger based on ANSYS Icepak
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: As one of the most important charging facilities for electric vehicles, DC chargers provide power supplements for electric vehicles.With the continuous development of DC chargers, the power density of their internal functional modules is also increasing. It is urgent to choose a reasonable heat dissipation method to reduce the overall temperature rise inside the DC charger and ensure its safe operation. In this paper, the 80kW DC charger is taken as the research object, and based on ANSYS Icepak thermal simulation software, the internal temperature field and fluid field of the DC charger are simulated and analyzed, and the design scheme of the DC charger is optimized by studying the heat dissipation system. Finally, the optimization scheme of the air duct structure of the system is obtained by adjusting the position of the heat dissipation fan.

articleTitle: Particle Flow Filter: An Ingenious Method to Predict the Remaining Useful Life of Lithium-Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The use of particle filter to predict the remaining useful life of lithium-ion batteries is challenged by particle degradation, which can reduce prediction accuracy and result in computational resource waste. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach that leverages particle flow filter to estimate the state of health of lithium-ion batteries. Our method first establishes a dual exponential empirical model based on the performance degradation mechanism of lithium-ion batteries. We then use particle flow filter to predict the remaining capacity of the batteries. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, which achieves high prediction accuracy without suffering from particle degradation.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Trade-off Technology for Civil Aircraft Based on Function and Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The reliability trade-off is an important part of the reliability index allocation. The reliability trade-off design for civilian aircraft based on function and architecture mainly evaluates the reliability index allocation options from the perspective of function and task impact factors, economy and achievability, constructs a scoring system, and uses hierarchical analysis to weigh the reliability allocation options and finally selects the preferred option for the identified reliability architecture.

articleTitle: Cooperative Maintenance Policy and Pricing Scheme for a Leased Series Manufacturing System
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Lease is an important mode of service-oriented manufacturing. A manufacturer may lease multiple machines from different suppliers to assemble a manufacturing system. We need to find the optimal maintenance policy for the system, and make a reasonable lease pricing scheme to promote the realization of the cooperative maintenance among the suppliers. In this paper, an optimization model is proposed to obtain a long-term maintenance policy for the system by minimizing a cost rate function. Then, the lease pricing scheme is proposed considering the marginal contributions of each supplier in the cooperation which are measured by the Shapley value method that is able to achieve fairness in profit allocation. Finally, a case study is used to show the application of the proposed methods for determining maintenance policy and pricing the lease.

articleTitle: Failure Mode Risk Analysis of DC Charger Based on Cloud Model and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: This paper overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional Risk assessment method of Risk Priority Number (RPN). The evaluation process is established by combining the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) with the cloud model theory. And applied to solve the DC charger failure mode risk assessment, analysis and determination of DC charger key failure mode and failure mechanism. Firstly, the expert assessment information of DC charger fault mode was converted into a cloud model, and then the risk assessment index and expert weight of risk assessment were calculated. Finally, the TOPSIS method was used to determine the risk priority of the fault mode, and the failure mechanism of the high-priority fault mode was analyzed to determine the failure physical model.

articleTitle: Study on the Calculation Method of Operational Availability of Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Based on the comprehensive consideration of aircraft scheduled maintenance factors, unscheduled maintenance factors and the level of aviation spares guarantee, this paper develops the calculation method and process of aircraft-level and system-level availability indexes for civil aircraft, and proposes a method to allocate availability based on the number of unscheduled removals in a hierarchical manner. The calculation method can not only guide the determination of aircraft-level and system-level operational availability indexes for civil aircraft, but also be applied to the assessment of civil aircraft operational availability in the operation phase, which is of great significance to ensure the utilization rate of civil aircraft and reduce the operation cost.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Reducer Based on Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet and Morphology
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty in extracting vibration signal features of coal reducer, a fault feature extraction strategy combining dual-tree complex wavelet and morphological filtering was proposed. The first step is to decompose the vibration signal of the reducer into several components in different frequency bands by using dual-tree complex wavelet. According to the frequency distribution characteristics of reducer fault characteristics, the relevant frequency band components are selected for noise reduction and reconstruction. In the second step, the reconstructed component with fault characteristic frequency is processed by morphological filtering, and then the fault characteristics of the reducer are extracted. The results show that the fault feature extraction strategy can effectively extract the fault features of the reducer and verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the diagnosis strategy.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Series Performance Sharing Systems Considering Transmission Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Existing research about performance sharing systems (PSSs) centered around the system reliability optimization problems of common bus performance sharing systems (CBPSSs). Aiming at enriching the existing research, this paper investigates the performance allocation optimization problem of a series PSS. Different from CBPSSs, the surplus performance of each component in the investigated system is only allowed to be transmitted to the adjacent components. Moreover, transmission loss is considered. The system reliability is calculated by a recursive algorithm based on universal generating function. Genetic algorithm is utilized to seek the optimal performance allocation policy to maximize the system reliability. A numerical example validates the effectiveness of the proposed method in reliability optimization.

articleTitle: Research on the Stator Inter-turn Short Circuit Fault Diagnosis Method of PMSM Based on the Continuous Spectrum Zoom
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Stator inter-turn short circuit fault is the cause of most occurring stator faults, and thus whether this fault can be detected in time is the key to ensure the operation reliability of the permanent magnet synchronous motor. The magnitude of the third harmonic in motor current can be used as the stator fault signature. However, in practice, as a result of small amplitude and spectrum leakage, it is difficult to extract the third harmonic component correctly, leading to misdiagnosis. To solve this problem, a continuous spectrum zoom Fourier analysis method based on the FFT and FT is proposed to correct the spectrum error, which has advantages of high frequency resolution and high amplitude calculation accuracy. Firstly, the cause of the third harmonic characteristic in motor current is analyzed. Then, the principle of continuous spectrum zoom method is introduced briefly. Furthermore, the extraction of the characteristic is described as three steps: fundamental frequency calculation, third harmonic frequency and its zoom frequency range computation, and the continuous spectrum zoom analysis. Finally, the experimental results verify the proposed continuous spectrum zoom method. It can be seen from the results that the amplitude of the third harmonic of the fault motor is larger than that of the health motor, where the amplitude increases as the number of the shorted turns, which proves that the third harmonic in motor current is an effective component to recognize the stator inter-turn short circuit fault.

articleTitle: Few-shot Fault Diagnosis Based on Supervised Contrast Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has performed extremely well in the field of fault diagnosis of rolling bearings due to its powerful feature extraction capability. However, in the case of a very small dataset of labelable samples, fault diagnosis still faces the status quo of insufficient feature learning and inaccurate fault category differentiation. This paper proposes a supervised contrast learning framework based on few samples. In the proposed framework, firstly, a small number of samples are passed through an encoder for feature extraction. Second, the similarity and difference of labeled samples are used to construct positive and negative sample pairs. Finally, the features learned by the encoder after contrast learning are passed through a classifier to achieve fault classification. The framework in this paper greatly reduces the time cost of manual preparation of labels. Experimental results show that the bearing fault diagnosis model proposed in this paper has high diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: Contact Force Analysis of the Aviation Spline Drive System under the Influence of Misalignment and Unbalanced Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Due to the coupling factors such as manufacturing error, assembly error and base deformation, it is easy to induce the early misalignment and unbalance fault of the aviation spline transmission system, resulting in serious wear of the aviation spline and reducing the service life of the transmission system. In view of the serious spline wear phenomenon, this paper takes a certain type of aviation spline transmission system as the research object, based on SolidWorks and Adams, rigid connection model and flexible connection model of aviation spline drive system are constructed, the change of contact force under the influence of misalignment and unbalance fault is compared and analyzed. The results show that with the increase of misalignment, the contact force of rigid connection and flexible connection increases gradually, but the rigid connection increases sharply; The peak-to-peak and root-mean-square values of the contact force of the flexible connection of the aviation spline drive system are much smaller than those of the rigid connection; The flexible connection of the aviation spline drive system significantly reduces the contact force of misalignment and unbalance faults. The research results can be used as reference for reducing spline wear and designing high-reliability and long-life aviation spline drive system.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Algorithm for Power Module Based on A Hybrid Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Fault diagnosis has a significant contribution to the reliability of the power module, the stability and accuracy of the fault diagnosis algorithm based on single-channel data have major limitations, and existing fault diagnosis algorithms based on multi-channel data have limitations such as insufficient capability of extracting features and low utilization rate of inter-channel correlation information. Therefore, in this paper, a multi-channel fault diagnosis algorithm for power modules based on a hybrid attention network is proposed, aiming at solving the problems of limited fault characterization capability of single-channel data and insufficient feature extraction of existing multi-channel input models. The hybrid attention module of this network adopts a mechanism that combines time attention and channel attention to extract the features of multi-channel data from both channel and time series dimensions of the input data in a holistic manner. The experiments have demonstrated that the hybrid attention network proposed in this paper achieves an accuracy of 99.40% in the multi-channel fault diagnosis test set, which is highly state-of-the-art and practicable, and can provide new ideas and methods for the research in fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Design of a Vibration-Sensing Tool Holder for High-Quality Signal Measurement in Milling Process
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Vibration signal measurement plays a critical role in monitoring the state of the milling process. However, conventional vibration measuring often relies on accelerometers mounted on workpieces or spindle heads, which are located far from the cutting point. As a result, these methods yield signals with a low signal-to-noise ratio. To overcome this limitation and obtain high-quality vibration signals during the milling process, this research paper introduces a highly integrated vibration-sensing tool holder that combines vibration sensors with the milling tool holder itself, designing corresponding signal processing and wireless transmission modules to facilitate data transfer. By integrating the sensors at a reasonable place closer to the cutting point, the vibration-sensing tool holder significantly reduces signal attenuation and improves data consistency. Vibration signals in all stages of milling are recorded by the tool holder. Then, Comparative milling experiments were conducted to verify the superiority of the customized tool holder.

articleTitle: Maximum Spectral Method for Non-Stationary Random Vibration Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to determine the environmental test conditions with nonstationary random vibration data, two methods of maximum spectral analysis have been summed up. These two methods are FFT and digital filter, which are based on short-time Fourier transform and minimum mean-square error criterion. Then, the advantages, disadvantages, and relative error with different bandwidth are discussed, and then examples are given to testify the better method. The theoretic analysis and simulation results show that: the relative error is minimum with conventional FFT computations with proportional resolution bandwidth. After applying the conventional FFT computations to the determination of environmental conditions for a certain product with 9 groups of nonstationary vibration data, the result is reasonable and effective. Therefore, the conventional FFT is the best method to deal with nonstationary random vibration data, which provides guidance for formulating the environmental conditions based on maximum spectral.

articleTitle: An Innovation of Creating Condition Based Work Items in Continuous Airworthiness Maintenance Program
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Condition based maintenance (CBM) has been used in airline and MRO for many years, but it is very hard to get approval of replacing preventive work items with CBM items from CAAC, because data integrity cannot satisfy airworthiness authority requirements. Ameco started to research technology and establish management system including airplane data acquirement software, airplane system model, algorithm, maintenance credit, CBM management process since 2020, and had breakthroughs of obtainment of CAAC airworthiness approval in April 2022. Implementation of CBM work item of A320 air conditioner heat exchanger remove and clean was very successful in 2022 and 2023, we plan to extend CBM work items to other type of airplane in the future.

articleTitle: Distributional Difference-Based Dynamic Adaptation for Bearing Performance Degradation Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Bearings are critical components in rotating machinery, where real-time monitoring of its health is essential to improve machine safety and productivity. However, the degradation trend of vibration signals collected during equipment operation is often unconspicuous, poor monotonicity, and large wave nature, making it difficult to accurately assess bearing performance. Considering the above issues, this study proposes a distribution difference-based dynamic adaptation method (DD-DAM), which uses the constructed distribution structure to evaluate the bearing state information. It includes three simple steps: first, the sample set was established based on a small number of healthy samples, from which a certain percentage of samples were randomly selected and their mean distribution was calculated as the baseline distribution. Then, Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence was used to obtain the maximum distribution difference distance D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> in the healthy sample set. Finally, the evaluation results are given by comparing the difference between D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> and the monitoring status. The validity of the method was verified on the bearing experimental data set. In addition, compared with Gaussian mixture model (GMM) and principal component analysis (PCA) through quantitative assessment, DD-DAM showed significant advantages in evaluating the bearing health status.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Identification for Compressor Blades using Vibration Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Variety of flow fields and impact of foreign objects may cause the changing of excitation loads for low pressure compressors. Thus, accurate identification of excitation load plays an important role in compressor blades condition monitoring. Although it is hard to measure forces on blades directly, vibration-based condition monitoring methods are widely used to obtain blades vibration signals. In this paper, a dynamic load identification method is proposed for compressor blades based on blade strain and vibration displacement signals. Firstly, dynamic model of blades is built to calculate blade tip displacement responses in theory. Secondly, a regularization method is conducted on blade excitation loads identification through blades tip displacements. Finally, within blade strain and tip displacements signals, the applicability of the proposed method is validated by identifying the harmonic excitation loads. The relative errors between the input forces and identification results in experiment are less than 1.1% and the identified load result is feasible.

articleTitle: Reweighted Dynamic Mode Decomposition for Fault Feature Extraction of Rolling Element Bearings
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Rolling element bearing is an indispensable component of rotating machinery, and many engineering cases have shown that the breakdown of equipment is related to bearing failures. Therefore, the significance of diagnosing faults in bearings cannot be overstated. However, the complex composition of bearing vibration signals makes fault information difficult to obtain directly. Conventional signal decomposition methods are effective in removing noise, but fault impulses are still mixed with harmonic components. Accurately separating fault impulses from signals under the interference of harmonics and noise has become an urgent problem. In this paper, we propose a correlated kurtosis (CK)-based reweighted dynamic mode decomposition (RDMD), which can filter out the fault-related modes by CK and reweight the fault impulses signal by these modes sub-signals. Applying the proposed RDMD and conventional signal decomposition methods to simulated and experimental signals, the results confirm that RDMD is effective in extracting fault impulses in the presence of harmonic and noise.

articleTitle: Secure and Private Fault Detections of Wind Turbine Through Blockchain-Enabled Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Fault detection is a major issue in wind energy field, and data-driven methods required a large amount of IoT data, posing risks of data security and privacy. To address this issue, this paper proposed a blockchain-enhanced federated learning model, i.e., BEFL, for wind turbine fault detection, wherein traditional federated learning was improved by eliminating the reliance on a central server, ensuring better privacy protection and security, and verification mechanisms were included in blockchain to enhance defense against malicious attacks. Experimental results demonstrated the privacy-preserving advantages of the BEFL framework for fault detection data. Overall, the framework provided a secure, confidential, and reliable solution for the maintenance and operation of wind turbine systems.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Lifetime Prediction Based on the GRU and Stochastic Degradation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: To further reduce the complexity of the algorithm and improve the performance of remaining useful lifetime (RUL) prediction, an RUL prediction method based on the gated recurrent unit (GRU) and stochastic degradation modeling is proposed. First, a stochastic degradation model based on the Wiener process is established and a weighted kernel function is used to represent its drift increment. Then, a GRU is established to predict the degradation increment of the Wiener process and derive the probability density function (PDF) of the RUL. Finally, based on the lithium battery degradation data, the validity of the method is verified.

articleTitle: An Optimal Design Method of Metal Filter Element Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The stainless steel sintered felt filter element is the key component of the liquid cooling system filter in ship, aviation, aerospace and other fields. The filter can filter most impurities from the fluid medium, reduce the influence of impurities on the equipment liquid cooling system, and improve the reliability of the liquid cooling system. However, there is an opposite relationship between the life of the filter element and the volume weight, which is also the focus of the field of light weight demand such as ships, aviation, aerospace, and so on, there is still no an effective filter element parameter optimization design method. Therefore, this paper presents an optimal design method of the sintered felt filter element of stainless steel based on genetic algorithm. The proposed method takes the maximum allowable size, the maximum allowable mass, the maximum allowable flow resistance, the maximum flow rate, and the requirement of filtration accuracy as the constraint conditions, aiming at maximizing the service life of the filter element. The optimized model is solved by genetic algorithm. Finally, a numerical case is presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed optimization method.

Author Keywords: sintered stainless steel felt filter element

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Reliability in Radiology Service Systems Based on Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Radiological examination is one of the bottlenecks in the hospital service system. Considering the randomness of patient arrival and service duration, this paper employs cellular automata to simulate the service process of different types of examination machines for patients with different examination demands, and the impact of the number of different types of machines on the system's service capability. Based on the operation process and historical data from the radiology department of a large general hospital in Sichuan Province, a cellular automaton model is constructed to explore a reasonable number of examination machines through simulation to achieve supply-demand balance. The simulation results provide reference value for management optimization and control.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method For Autonomous Underwater Vehicles Based On Neural Network With Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Aiming at the autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV), each system module has the characteristics of strong coupling and nonlinearity, which leads to the existence of strong nonlinear relationship between various types of faults and fault features, and the information content of a single signal is limited, which can not meet the diagnosis requirements. For this reason, a fault diagnosis model based on the attention mechanism convolutional neural network (SE-CNN) is proposed. Firstly, the SE attention mechanism module is introduced to fuse the vibration acceleration features in different directions. Second, the convolutional neural network is combined for further feature extraction and fault identification. Finally, experimental validation is carried out by the public dataset of AUV and compared with other state-of-the-art methods. The results show that the SE-CNN model has a good diagnostic effect on the fault data of AUVs and can successfully detect different fault types with high accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Availability Assessment of the LEO Satellite Communication System with the Consideration of Satellite Handover
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Satellite handover frequently occurs on low-earth-orbit (LEO) satellite communication systems, and it affects system availability. However, existing studies neglected such an impact. To solve the problem above, this paper proposed a topology modeling method, in which the satellite dynamic operation is divided into small time slices to simplify the system, and the earth ground is divided into grids to abstract the ground user's communication requirement.
