Then, the service availability is defined according to the key performance parameter of the communication service, delay, and a Monte Carlo-based availability assessment method is addressed with the consideration of the satellite handover. Finally, a case is used to analyze how satellite handover strategies affect service availability. and suggestions are given to improve system availability.

Index Terms: Low Earth Orbit Satellite Communication Systems

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of ABS Wheel Speed Sensor Based on Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: To achieve the diagnosis of different types of faults in the wheel speed sensors for anti-lock braking system (ABS), BP neural network was introduced to establish a BP neural network diagnostic model. In order to address issues such as slow convergence and overfitting, an improved BP neural network based on L-M algorithm was proposed. Additionally, the concept of sensor voltage was introduced to train the network using 400 samples and diagnose faults such as open circuit, large gap, and small gap in wheel speed sensors. The improved BP neural network achieved an accuracy rate of nearly 100% for diagnosing different faults in wheel speed sensors, thereby enhancing the pattern recognition and diagnostic capabilities when ABS wheel speed sensors encounter various malfunctions. This study validates the feasibility and accuracy of using BP neural networks to diagnose faults in wheel speed sensors.

articleTitle: A Novel Learning Approach to MIMO Networked Control Systems with Uncertain Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: This paper proposes a new learning approach to solve control design problems involving uncertain parameters in MIMO networked control systems. This approach combines neural network technology with control system modeling in real-time through learning and adaptation of data, thereby achieving stability and optimization of network-based control systems. The authors first establish a network-based control model and then improve it by replacing the linear parameters with nonlinear ones. To ensure real-time and stable communication between devices, this method also uses adaptive iterative learning control (AILC) technology and error feedback control technology. A network-based control system is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The results show that this approach is effective in achieving sufficient communication between devices, adapting to uncertain parameters, and improving control performance.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Frequency Weighted Energy Operator and its Application in Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to extract the fault features of rolling bearings under strong noise, a new feature enhancement method named fractional order frequency weighted energy operator (FFWEO) is proposed. Firstly, Fourier transform is used to transform the signal from time domain to frequency domain to obtain the amplitude function and phase function. Secondly, set the variation range and step size of differential order, perform fractional differential processing on the amplitude function of the signal in the frequency domain according to the time domain differential property of Fourier transform, combine the amplitude function with the phase function, and then use the inverse Fourier transform to obtain the modified signal. Thirdly, Hilbert transform is applied to differential signals of different orders to obtain envelope signals. The envelope kurtosis index is used to select the best differential order, and the envelope spectrum is obtained from differential signals to determine the bearing fault mode. The experimental results show that the method can effectively extract the fault features of rolling bearings under the strong noise background.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Passenger Elevator Block Brake Based on Composite Gamma Crocess
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Passenger elevator block brakes play an important role in ensuring the safe and smooth operation of elevators and safeguarding passenger safety. Firstly, according to the structure and working principle of the block brake, the main failure modes of the block brake are analyzed, the braking torque is identified as the main performance index of the block brake, and a composite degradation model of the braking torque consisting of two Gamma processes is established to characterize the degradation of the braking torque; finally, the test is carried out, and a reliability analysis is performed on the model of the brake.

articleTitle: Decision Method of Operation and Maintenance of CBTC System Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: At present, the failure disposal process for the CBTC system relies heavily on the personal experience of practitioners, and the level of intelligence is at a low level. At the same time, the valuable information in the failure log text is not effectively exploited. Aiming at these problems, this paper proposes a decision-making method for CBTC system operation and maintenance(O&M) based on knowledge graph. First, the knowledge graph construction process is built by combining top-down and bottom-up methods, and the schema layer of the whole failure O&M process is designed by combining expert knowledge. Then, the BERT pre-training model is applied to extract failure entities from the labeled dataset, and the experiment is used to prove the good performance of this model. Next, the extracted entities and their relationships are in the form of nodes and edges for failure knowledge graph is populated and visualized using Neo4j. Finally, the CBTC system O&M knowledge graph is applied to give the failure cause tracing and maintenance suggestion generation method, and the usability of the proposed method is verified with examples, which can effectively assist practitioners to make the O&M decision.

articleTitle: Bearing Remaining Useful Life Prediction Based on BERT Fine-tuning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Rotating machinery are the cornerstone of indus-trial, and the prediction of critical bearing life model has always been a research hotspot. However, the prediction accuracy of most bearing remaining useful life (RUL) prediction networks still needs to be improved, and the training time can be further shortened. This paper proposed a fine-tuning BERT model for predicting the RUL of bearings. Based on the output form of the BERT model word segmentation module and the NLP task, the health index from bearing vibration data was extracted, and combined with the BERT model to achieve bearing RUL prediction. The performance of the proposed method was verified on the XJTU-SY bearing dataset. The results showed that the BERT model achieved superior RUL prediction performance in training speed and prediction accuracy, indicating its great potential for the field.

articleTitle: Enhancing Impairment Detection in Full-Band Capture (FBC) Downstream Spectrum Data Using Unsupervised Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Ensuring the reliability of telecommunication networks is paramount in today's interconnected world. To address this critical challenge, this study introduces a comprehensive preprocessing framework tailored for the full-band capture (FBC) downstream spectrum data for impairment detection. The proposed approach initiates with the identification of optimal clustering algorithms and cluster configurations, followed by within-cluster outlier detection which is a crucial preprocessing step. Subsequently, the study delves into amplitude groupings, aimed at elevating impairments detection accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach, showcasing improved data quality and highlighting the adaptability required in preprocessing pipelines, given the variability in algorithm and cluster count selection across diverse datasets. This research represents a significant step forward in advancing network maintenance, enhancing impairment detection tasks by providing robust preprocessing techniques for diverse FBC downstream spectrum datasets.

articleTitle: A General Intelligent Method for Degradation Sensitive Parameters Extraction and Life Prediction of Bipolar Transistor
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In recent years, key instrumentation and control devices in the nuclear power industry have entered the life depletion period. Due to diverse failure mechanisms and scatter orbits of degradation, the life of core component Bipolar Transistor is difficult to be determined. A migration learning based life prediction method is proposed to determine the sensitive degradation mechanism parameters. According to the degradation mechanism, the degradation principle of transistor is given, and degradation path of the R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">BE</inf>, R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">BC</inf>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex> parameters are proposed. A Bayesian classifier algorithm is developed to classify the triode to be tested into one of the pre-defined types according to the measured parameter values. Finally, the proposed three-parameter competitive degradation model is used to obtain the final triode lifetime distribution with reference to the parameter degradation curve corresponding to the type. The application case demonstrate that the method can intelligently generalize the degradation characteristic of different kind of transistor to get the accurate prediction of lifetime through empirical data, reduce the test costs significantly.

articleTitle: Instance Segmentation Method of Tunnel Facility Images Along High-Speed Rail based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In order to ensure the normal operation of high-speed rail, the safety risks of tunnel facilities along the high-speed rail are the focus of safety inspections. In recent years, the remote inspection method of unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) has gradually replaced manual inspection. With large amounts of data collected from image captures, there is a high demand for accurate identification of inspection targets, posing a major challenge for researchers. This study focuses on a deep neural network-based instance segmentation method to assist inspection personnel in eliminating complex background interference from UAV-captured images, accurately identifying facility hazards, and reducing missed detections and false alarms. Specifically, considering the dispersed locations of tunnel facilities along high-speed rail, the SOLOv2 model is employed to directly segment different facility targets using their position information. To address the low precision issue caused by imbalanced dataset distribution, a Balanced Focal Loss is proposed to balance the model parameters. To improve the segmentation boundary precision, a Self-Adaptive Boundary Refinement method is proposed and applied after SOLOv2. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a 2.6% improvement in average precision(AP) compared to the state-of-the-art instance segmentation method SOLOv2, reaching 61.1% AP on the tunnel entrance facility image dataset. Our method can be applied to remote inspection tasks of tunnel facilities along high-speed rail.

Author Keywords: tunnel facility images along high-speed rail

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation Method of Vehicle On-Board Controller of Train Control System Based on Hawkes Process
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Reliability assessment is an important approach to reduce the risk of equipment failure, improve operational quality, and reduce life-cycle costs. Based on the real fault event of a certain operation line of urban rail transit, a reliability assessment method based on the Hawkes process is proposed. The Hawkes process is used to mathematically derive the reliability function of the vehicle on-board controller equipment for the train control system. The maximum likelihood estimation and genetic algorithm are used to optimize the parameters of the Hawkes process, and sensitivity of three important parameters is analyzed. The corresponding maintenance recommendations are also given. The research results show that the fitness function of parameter estimation of the Hawkes process reaches its optimum at the 7th iteration, and the reliability curve of the vehicle on-board controller equipment can be divided into three stages based on two time points of 2 months and 1 year. The mean time to failure of the equipment can be calculated using a formula and is approximately 217 days. During the first 2 months of operation, due to defects in design, raw materials, and manufacturing processes, the reliability of the equipment decreases rapidly. Therefore, it is necessary to increase the trial operation time of the equipment to ensure a smooth start-up. During the period of 2 months to 1 year of operation, the equipment operates more smoothly, and the rate of decrease in reliability is slower. Daily maintenance should be carried out to check for any abnormal equipment operating conditions. After operating for more than 1 year, equipment failures occur frequently, and the rate of decrease in reliability is fast. Therefore, the equipment should be repaired or replaced as necessary to ensure safe, stable, and efficient operation. Through sensitivity analysis of the three important parameters in the reliability assessment process, it is found that parameter β is positively correlated with reliability, while parameters μ and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> are negatively correlated with the reliability function. When changing by the same magnitude, parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> has the greatest impact on equipment reliability, followed by parameter μ, and parameter β has the lowest impact on equipment reliability. The research results provide important theoretical support for improving the safe operation of vehicle on-board controller equipment for train control systems and reducing operating costs.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Method for Fault Diagnosis of Industrial Equipment Based on Vibration Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Industrial equipment reliability is a critical issue that smart manufacturing systems must address. Implementation of online fault diagnosis for industrial equipment is a promising technology that can improve equipment reliability. Vibration analysis is a popular technique for equipment condition monitoring. For the non-linear and non-stationary features of industrial vibration signals, a hybrid model based on wavelet transform (WT), support vector machine (SVM), and grey wolf optimization algorithm (GWO) is proposed. The time-frequency domain features of fault signals are extracted by wavelet transform to solve the non-linearity of signals, and the obtained feature vectors are input into SVM for classification. Aiming at the problem of setting penalty coefficient and kernel function parameters, GWO is introduced to seek hyperparameters by using the hunting principle of wolves. In the experimental part, firstly, the comparison of the GWO-WT-SVM, GWO-SVM and SVM models was carried out. Secondly, Comparison with classical classification algorithms is made. Apparently, the GWO-WT-SVM model achieves higher accuracy than other models in bearing fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction Based on Sequential Bayesian Approach for Railway Balise
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Balise plays an important role in Chinese train control system. Based on the principle of coupling circuit, it realizes the point-to-point information transmission between train and ground, and is used to determine the train running direction. However, during the operation of the balise, its circuit components will inevitably degrade and eventually lead to system failure. Since the degradation process must consider the effects of natural degradation and sudden shocks, and according to different conditions, the degradation curve conforms to a variety of different nonlinear distributions, it is not easy to predict the system failure time or remaining useful life (RUL) of the balise. This paper introduces a method combining interactive multi-model particle filter (IMMPF) and Metropolis-Hastings (MH) sampling algorithm, namely IMMPF-MH. It is used to update the online parameters of the dependent competing failure process (DCFP) model and predict the RUL of the balise based on the first arrival time concept. IMMPF algorithm works well in dealing with nonlinear and non-Gaussian systems, while MH is easy to deal with the diversity of time series distribution characteristics. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the model. Compared with other methods, the error is smaller, the parameter estimation is more accurate, and the RUL of the balise can be predicted more accurately with less sampling data.

articleTitle: The effect analysis of the excitation frequency on the output signal of an inductive sensor for the detection of wear debris in lubrication oil
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The inductive sensor has found a wide application in the wear fault real-time monitoring, the excitation frequency setting plays a significant role in the detection of the debris size, especially for various material debris. In this work, the mathematic model of a three-coil inductive sensor is presented, and the finite element simulation model is established to explore the effect of the excitation frequency on the output signal of a sensor. An experimental platform is set up to verify the influence rules acquired by the finite element analysis and the detection ability for various engineering material debris. The experimental results show that the effectiveness of the influence rules and provide a beneficial reference for the design of an inductive sensor. By studying the output signal of the sensor under different frequencies, the optimal excitation frequency is determined, which makes the monitoring effect of the sensor more accurate and reliable. Using the excitation frequency, the sensor is designed to monitor the wear of parts of different materials, improve the effectiveness of monitoring, and realize the monitoring of different materials. The verification experiment is based on the friction and wear experiment platform to simulate a variety of working conditions, and the materials selected are from vulnerable parts of large complex rotating machinery equipment, which has practical engineering application value.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Fault diagnosis algorithms for devices based on deep learning have flourished in recent years. However, there are limitations in the actual engineering application of the model. Because data privacy concerns may arise when using multi-party data to build models, and existing models lack interpretability. To address these issues, taking wind turbine bearing as an example, this paper proposes a federated graph isomorphism network model for fault diagnosis based on causal discovery using federated learning (FL). Firstly, for the non-stationary bearing vibration signal, we use the fusion wavelet convolution (FWConv) method to extract the fault features of the signal. Secondly, the causation between features is discovered by using federated directed acyclic graph structure learning (FedDAG) algorithm. Finally, a federated graph isomorphic network (FedGIN) fault diagnosis model is constructed and compared with the local model of client, GCN and other models. Experimental results show that the proposed model can protect data privacy while achieving the same training effect as centralized graph neural network models.

articleTitle: Path Planning and Tracking Control of Unmanned Ship Based on Improved Artificial Potential Field Method and A-Star Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: During the navigation process of unmanned ships, unmanned ships must be able to plan a reasonable path between the starting and the end point, and on the basis of this, the tracking tasks need to be completed. In response to this issue, this article proposes the planning method and tracking control method based on the improved artificial potential method and the unmanned ship path of the A-star algorithm. Adding a scaling factor to the repulsion function and combining the two algorithms effectively solves the problem that traditional artificial potential field methods are prone to local minima. After smoothing the planned path, it is used as the input of the controller. Based on the backstepping sliding mode method, the controller of the underactuated unmanned ship is designed, which solves the problem that the external environment cannot be considered in the traditional path planning. The effectiveness of path planning and tracking control of unmanned ships based on the improved artificial potential field method and A-star algorithm is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: An Overview of Industry-related Grid Forming Inverter Controls
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The potential of weak grid scenarios resulting from increased penetration of inverter-based resources (IBRs) and gradual retirement of synchronous generators (SGs) has drawn much attention to the research and implementation of various inverter control strategies. This paper presents an overview of key industry-related grid-forming (GFM) inverter control technologies, summarizing their strengths and weaknesses for grid-interactive operations under several operating conditions. This investigation also addresses the conceptual distinction between GFM and grid-following (GFL) inverters, highlighting the need for GFM inverter technologies to provide grid support functions, especially in weak grid areas. Theoretical analyses are validated through simulation models built under various operating modes of load variations and unexpected phase interruptions to verify the ability of GFM technology to contribute to grid strength in the absence of SGs. When analyzed, the results suggest that GFM technology can achieve desirable grid stability and reliability efficiency even in the absence of SGs.

articleTitle: Stability Study of Robotic Drilling System Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Digital twin technology has been widely incorporated into industrial maintenance to enhance Prognostics and Health Monitoring (PHM) systems and improve system stability. However, the stability of robotic drilling system is affected by various factors such as cutting force and vibration which are difficult to control. Therefore, this paper proposes a digital twin-based stability architecture for robotic drilling systems. The overall virtual entity model of the system is studied by mathematical and physical method, and the virtual entity and physical entity of the system operates simultaneously by combining the virtual and physical mapping of the system. In order to improve the stability of the system, a quality prediction and optimization model is established to solve the quality problems in the process of system operation. The experimental results demonstrate that the twin model exhibits a high level of accuracy in robot drilling. It has the capability to monitor key parameters in real-time during the machining process and retain data throughout the operation. By leveraging mathematical models for prediction and optimization, it effectively enhances the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Reliability-Redundancy Allocation for System Under Mixed Active, Cold and Warm Standby Redundancy With Weibull Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Redundancy allocation is common in reliability engineering. There has been extensive researches on this topic, but the study on systems that simultaneously incorporate active, warm, and cold redundancy with Weibull distribution is less. Accordingly, the reliability-redundancy allocation problem (RRAP) on this system is focused on in this paper. The reliability of the series-parallel system with active, cold standby and warm standby redundancy is analyzed using the counting process. Based on the reliability model, the optimization model is established with the goal of system reliability maximization under the constraints concerning cost and weight. Further, a genetic algorithm is used to solve this model. The proposed method is applied to a modified benchmark problem. Results from the model computation and sensitivity analysis reveal that this study makes the RRAP benchmark problems more reliable and provides system designers with a wider flexibility.

articleTitle: A Diagnosis Method for Assembly Deviation Based on Structure-Variable Dynamic Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The quality of mechanical assembly is of utmost importance in ensuring the overall product quality and operational performance. However, the existing methods for diagnosing mechanical assembly deviations often fail to meet the practical requirements for assessing assembly quality. This paper introduces a novel approach by incorporating probabilistic graphical model theory into the manufacturing field. Proposing an assembly deviation diagnosis method based on Structure-Variable Dynamic Bayesian Networks (SVDBN). Initially, the assembly process is analyzed, and the dynamic structure and node types of the network are defined. The stress effects resulting from assembly deviations are examined, and the dependency relationships between the nodes are determined. Through learning the initial network and the probability table of the transfer network for each time slice, constructing a diagnostic network model. Subsequently, a forward and backward operator inference algorithm is introduced, which utilizes the network structure to gather evidence variables during the assembly process of the actual system. This enables us to infer the probabilities associated with each deviation source. Finally, the proposed method is validated using the winder chuck shaft assembly to verify the feasibility of the SVDBN model in diagnosing mechanical assembly deviations.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction Method of Rolling Bearing Based on UMDGRU
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The estimate of rolling bearing remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of is an essential component of complex system prognostics and health management (PHM). Aiming at the problem of overfitting in the operation of data-driven RUL prediction model, the ability of capturing temporal features is reduced, an unsupervised multi-scale densely gated recurrent unit (UMDGRU) RUL prediction method is proposed. By using the unsupervised manifold regularization stack denoising autoencoder (MRSDAE) network to initially extract features and train parameters, the initial parameters of the feature layer are provided for the prediction network; then the UMDGRU prediction network is constructed for RUL prediction, which By incorporating multi-scale layers, jumping layers and dense layers, it therefore has the ability to capture time series features and integrate attentional information at different time scales, effectively preventing the overfitting of the network. The dataset validates the efficiency of the suggested method for RUL prediction; the suggested method has superior capacity for generalization and higher accuracy in forecasting when compared to other data-driven based methods.

articleTitle: A Multi-state Economy Quantification Method of Structural Health Monitoring System for Helicopter Composite Blades
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The application of structural health monitoring system in helicopters is still at preliminary stage, and one of the reasons is the difficulty to assess the economic benefits before its application. As a complex system, helicopter has more than two performance levels, and the binary reliability theory cannot accurately describe the state of its structure. In this regard, this paper proposes a multi-state economy quantification method for structural health monitoring system, which integrates the Bayesian-based value of information theory. Considering the multi-state characteristic of helicopter blades, a framework is developed to access multi-state probabilistic model based on crack propagation theory and Monte Carlo simulation methods. Subsequently, a Bayesian decision-making method for quantifying economic value of monitoring information of helicopter blades was constructed. The structural state is probabilistically characterized and updated by using vibration monitoring information and Bayesian theory. Finally, taking the French dolphin blade maintenance as an example, the economics of the vibration-based helicopter monitoring system was quantified.

articleTitle: Research on Methods for Complex Equipment Performance Troubleshooting and Auxiliary Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In response to the fact that most complex equipment has been in service for a long time with high task intensity, and the failure rate of equipment has been increasing year by year, which seriously impacts the safety of equipment use, this paper presents a study on the method of complex equipment performance troubleshooting. Taking into account the effects on mission performance and safety, it analyzes the content and means of performance quality troubleshooting and constructs a probability risk model for equipment safety assessment, a simulation model for the success of equipment mission planning, a maintenance decision model based on technical status, and a warning and replacement model for life-limited parts. Building upon the aforementioned research, a comprehensive equipment status information management and auxiliary decision-making system is designed for day-to-day management and equipment self-repair, emergency repair, graded repair, equipment safety control, and mission capability assessment. This system aims to guide and assist maintenance personnel in conducting comprehensive performance troubleshooting of complex equipment, understanding the current quality and safety status of the equipment, timely identifying and resolving quality and safety issues, ensuring the good technical status of the equipment, and ensuring the safety of equipment use and mission execution.

articleTitle: Statistical Process Monitoring Based on Region Growing for Fused Deposition Modeling with Image Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) is a highly prevalent additive manufacturing technique. Product quality is of utmost importance for the success of FDM manufacturing process. Effective monitoring of the printing process enables timely detection of product defects and facilitates significant quality improvement by providing timely corrective actions. The advancement of machine vision is driving the development of statistical process monitoring (SPM) with images data in FDM process. Given that out-of-control FDM process may appear due to parameter drifts, a SPM method is proposed to monitor the status of the process. This method is for grayscale images of each printing layer, which are continuously captured by real-time industrial camera systems. Regions of interest (ROIs) are first determined by region growing, so as to locate the different positions of the unfilled regions. The generalized likelihood ratio (GLR) is introduced to establish statistical variables and find out the change point where the parameter shifts in the process, so as to realize the monitoring of the ROIs of each image. The probability of alarm in a specified period (PASP) and the cumulative PASP are used to determine the control limit and measure the monitoring performance of control chart. Both simulation and case study results demonstrate the proposed method exhibits the effectiveness in detecting faults in time and the precision in estimating their locations.

Author Keywords: Probability of alarm in a specified period

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Reconstruction Method of Oil Wear Particles Based on Binocular Stereo Microscopic Image
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: The three-dimensional reconstruction of oil wear particles can enhance understanding of their morphology and provide support for fault prediction and health management of aircraft engines. After acquiring binocular stereo microscopic images of abrasive grains in oil monitoring experiments, a model based on the principle of parallel binocular imaging can be established for 3D reconstruction without relying on precision instruments. Aiming at its limitation that the optical axis of the stereo microscope binocular camera is not parallel, which leads to a large amount of correction required in the stereo correction process, this paper proposes a three-dimensional reconstruction method based on the pyramid LK optical flow method. The comparative analysis of the results shows that this method can effectively reconstruct the three-dimensional morphology of oil abrasive particles within the allowable error range, and effectively reduce the errors introduced in the stereo correction process.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Gearbox under Variable Operating Conditions based on KPCA and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management Conference (PHM-Hangzhou)
abstract: In the field of gearbox research, the remaining useful life prediction for gears is a critical task. This paper investigates the essential technology for predicting the remaining useful life of gears. Firstly, the time synchronous averaging (TSA) algorithm is employed to reduce the noise in the vibration signal. The gear's vibration data is divided into six operating conditions based on torque changes. Secondly, to determine the variation rule of the remaining life of the gear, reduce the interference of different operating conditions, and extract appropriate fault parameters, healthy operating conditions are treated by different operating conditions, a vector autoregressive (VAR) model that considers the interaction of different independent variables is adopted for different operating conditions. Thirdly, after extracting features from the VAR data, kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) is used to reduce the dimensionality of the feature matrix while retaining as much original information as possible and reducing data volume. Finally, long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks are employed to predict the remaining life of the gear, avoiding possible safety hazards and economic losses. The average error between the predicted output value of the model and the actual value is 0.15%. The results demonstrate that this technique can accurately predict the remaining useful life of gears and provide practical support for equipment maintenance.
